我們在討論行動期間可能出現的 diplomatic 問題。此外，我們還談到了與企業（Enterprise）的關係以及其他計劃。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We also talked about the possible gains and losses for our two sides during this cooperation ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們也討論了這次合作中雙方可能獲得的利益和損失...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... Although it was committed by the enterprise, we cannot deny that it happened in our country. So we have to take some responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...雖然這是企業所為，但我們不能否認它發生在我們的國家。因此我們必須承擔一定的責任。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Yes. That's it.
But I'm not sure whether they could feel more comfortable with this kind compensation or contract ...
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
是的，就是這樣。
但我不確定他們是否更傾向於這種補償或契約...

scripts.text: They?
scripts.translation: 他們？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Once we sent delegates to Schwaltzvalt.
... And they never came back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們曾派遣代表前往施瓦茨瓦爾特（Schwaltzvalt）。
...但他們再也沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Come to think of it, you must have cleared your mission.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
仔細想想，你應該已經完成了任務。

scripts.text: Give him the Blessing Star.
scripts.translation: 給他祝福之星

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Terra Gloria, the surface is gone.
Only the star is remaining.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...泰拉·格洛麗亞（Terra Gloria），表面已經消失了。
只剩下星星了。

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
No, the surface is just a means to cover the star.
What matters is the star.
You have brought the right stuff.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
不，表面只是用來包裹星星的手段。
重要的是星星本身。
你帶來了正確的東西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Hmm? It's just a gem, isn't it?
Why on earth did they steal this?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
嗯？這只是一顆寶石，不是嗎？
他們為什麼要偷這個？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Because it is like a fine magic stone.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
因為它就像一塊精美的魔法之石。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.. Now they steal the materials for experiments?
There are several more facilities that are presumed to have secret laboratories like this.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...現在他們連實驗材料都偷？
據推測，還有幾個設施擁有像這樣的秘密實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Are you freaking out about the future?
We have already finished talking about it.
I told you that I would support you if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
你在擔心未來嗎？
我們已經討論過了。
我告訴過你，如果你需要，我會支援你。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... That was in reference to the mutual agreement. So please don't take the credit for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...那是指雙方的協議。請不要把功勞攬在自己身上。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Credit? I was just telling the truth.
Now, I don't have to be here anymore.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
功勞？我只是說了實話而已。
好了，我也不用留在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You are so cold.
Are you leaving right after obtaining what you want?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你真是冷漠。
拿到想要的東西就要立刻離開嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We will meet again, if necessary.
Tess, if you visit Prontera, you will be more than welcome.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
如果有必要，我們還會再見的。
泰絲，如果你來普隆德拉，我會非常歡迎你的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Besides, I don't have much time.
I have many things to handle when I get back.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
而且，我也沒多少時間了。
回去後還有很多事情要處理。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}.
Go back to the palace and wait in your room.
I will make sure that you get enough compensation.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}。
回到宮殿後，就在房間裡等著吧。
我會確保你得到足夠的補償。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Are we going back now?
I have a Scroll of Movement made by Nilem, the palace magician. Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我們現在要回去了嗎？
我有尼勒姆——宮廷魔法師製作的移動卷軸。要使用嗎？

scripts.text: Let me join you!!
scripts.translation: 讓我加入你們！！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
No, {0}, please talk to me for a while.
I would like to get some more!
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
不，{0}，請再和我聊一會兒。
我還想多聊點！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Skia, activate it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
斯基亞，發動它。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Yes~
Mr. Philopontess, so long!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
好~
菲洛龐特斯先生，再見！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Good to see you again.
I am glad you are safe.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
很高興再次見到你。
看到你還平安無事，我很高興。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
This happened because of me. So I came to resolve the crisis myself.
... It would be shameful of me to keep relying on others.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
這件事是因為我而發生的。所以我親自前來解決危機。
...一直依賴別人，對我來說是羞恥的。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Although I cannot help you physically,
I can take care of the information analysis and diplomatic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
...雖然我不能在體力上幫你，
但我可以負責情報分析和外交事務。

scripts.text: Have you been released from confinement?
scripts.translation: 你被解除禁閉了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm~ Unfortunately, no.
I reported to the elders of our royal family about this affair. I was scolded and barely got permission to come here.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯~ 很遺憾，沒有。
我向皇室的長老們彙報了這件事。我被責罵了，勉強才獲得許可來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
In the process, I took advantage of your name.
Officially, you are the key person resolving this crisis and I am the one who takes the responsibility. And Lady Skia is observing me.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
在這個過程中，我借用了你的名字。
官方說法是，你是解決這次危機的關鍵人物，而我負責承擔責任。至於斯基亞女士，則是在監督我。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Since they all know about you, everyone is expecting you resolve this by any means.
I apologize for having taken advantage of your name without informing you earlier.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
既然大家都知道了你的存在，所有人都在期待你無論如何都要解決這個問題。
抱歉，之前沒有告知你就借用了你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Without it, they would never have approved you.
They would have claimed that you had made things worse.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
如果沒有這樣做，他們絕不會批准你的。
他們會聲稱是你把事情搞得更糟了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
Let's talk about the operation ... Is your name Philopontess?
We are cooperating now, so may I tell you my opinion?
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們來談談行動吧... 你的名字是菲洛龐特斯嗎？
既然我們現在是合作關係，我可以告訴你我的意見嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course.
And please call me Tess.
The Rebellion will be in charge of the military operation. But ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
當然可以。
請叫我泰絲。
反叛者將負責軍事行動。但是...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
In terms of strategy, we are superior.
And we only have a single chance. So you are welcome to give us a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
在戰略方面，我們更勝一籌。
而且我們只有一次機會。所以，如果你有什麼好主意，儘管提出來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, he sure has a big mouth~
If my sister Elena heard it, she might have shot him in the head!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，他嘴巴真大~
如果我姐姐埃琳娜聽到這話，說不定會一槍崩了他的頭！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We've picked out the combatants. Since this operation is confidential, we selected those who we can fully trust.
And the investigation of the buildings and geographical features?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們已經挑選好了戰鬥人員。由於這次行動是機密的，我們只選了完全值得信賴的人。
至於對建築物和地形的調查呢？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Of course, we have provided it.
We have been investigating this place for quite a long time.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
當然，我們已經提供了。
我們對這個地方已經調查了相當長的時間。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I read the document.
The funny thing is here ... I don't know why. But there is
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我讀了那份檔案。
奇怪的事情在這裡... 我不知道為什麼。但是那裡

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
no retreat path in the area where the facility is located.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
該設施所在區域沒有撤退路線。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm. Then all we have to do is get in there and block the only entrance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯。那我們只需要進去，堵住唯一的入口就行了？

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
They might have installed a gate for teleport. We must disable it first.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
他們可能安裝了傳送門。我們必須先將其癱瘓。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
We must do it quickly, so that the enemy cannot take any countermeasures even if they recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我們必須迅速行動，這樣即使敵人察覺到了，也無法採取任何反制措施。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Leave it to us!
The Rebellion hasn't just been napping.
Then the rest here are all surplus manpower?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
交給我們吧！
反叛者可不是在睡覺。
那麼，剩下的這些人都是多餘的人力嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Did you say 'surplus'!?
Have you already forgotten who provided this information?
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你說什麼“多餘”！？
你已經忘了是誰提供的情報嗎？

scripts.text: ... The meeting is getting too long.
scripts.translation: ... 會議開得有點太長了。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Hmm ... It's boring, isn't it?
Things have been decided to some degree.
I won't be able to help you directly.
I'm here to watch Nihil.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
嗯... 很無聊，不是嗎？
事情已經大致決定了。
我無法直接幫你們。
我在這裡是為了監視尼希爾。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
What you have to concentrate on in this facility is the central room.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
你們在這個設施中需要集中注意力的是中樞室。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
What you are looking for might be in the place called the ^4d4dffcentral room^000000.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
你們要找的東西可能在被稱為^4d4dff中樞室^000000的地方。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
I stepped in to ensure a safe, successful procedure. But actually, we had already provided you with everything we can.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
我介入是為了確保程式安全、順利。但實際上，我們已經把能提供的都提供給你們了。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
{0}, once the Rebellion occupies the laboratory, you have to rush to the central room faster than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
{0}，一旦反叛者佔領實驗室，你必須比任何人都更快地衝向中樞室。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
And there ... you will find it.
I have a strong feeling that it is here.
I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
在那裡... 你會找到它的。
我有一種強烈的預感，它就在這裡。
我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Now let's get going.
It will be dark soon.
It's the end of the week, so security might not be so tight.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
現在出發吧。
天快黑了。
今天是週末，安保可能不會那麼嚴密。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
地點在^4d4dff艾音布羅克北方田野的一點鐘方向行動點^000000。
在田野裡，請與反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The exact ^4d4dffcoordinates of the operation spot are 280, 332^000000. The person in charge of the operation may be ... ^4d4dffJulian^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
行動點的精確^4d4dff座標是280, 332^000000。負責這次行動的人可能是... ^4d4dff朱利安^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Go find Julian!
Of course I'm going too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
去找朱利安！
當然，我也會一起去。

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
... 別忘了。
你必須到達中樞室，找到^4d4dff泰拉·格洛麗亞^000000。
祝你在戰爭中好運。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will take a chance and participate.
Take care of yourself!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會冒險參與進去的。
保重！

scripts.text:
[Nihil]
... Don't forget.
You absolutely must reach the central room and find the ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
I wish you fortune in war.
scripts.translation:
[尼希爾]
... 別忘了。
你必須到達中樞室，找到^4d4dff泰拉·格洛麗亞^000000。
祝你在戰爭中好運。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
地點在^4d4dff艾音布羅克北方田野的一點鐘方向行動點^000000。
在田野裡，請與反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Well, it seems like everyone is here. Maybe I can step out?
From now on, Rookie, the heron emeritus agent, will handle it!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
看來大家都到齊了。也許我可以退場了？
從現在開始，新人，這隻退休的鷺鳥特工會接手處理的！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I've done my job~
Now I'm counting on Rookie!
I'm on vacation from now on!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我的任務完成了~
接下來就指望你了，新人！
從現在起我要休假了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Most of the squadron will be standing by in the operation spot.
They will take a chance to start it, right?
I think they will get in when it gets dark ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
大部分小隊會在行動點待命。
他們會找機會發起進攻，對吧？
我想他們會在天黑時潛入...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's get there before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
趁還沒太晚，我們趕緊過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I will be in the shade.
Oh~ I'm excited to use a sword after such a long time!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我會躲在陰影裡。
啊~ 好久沒拿劍了，真讓人興奮！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The location is ^4d4dffOperation Spot in one o'clock, Northern field in Einbroch^000000.
In the field, please cooperate with the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
地點在^4d4dff艾音布羅克北方田野的一點鐘方向行動點^000000。
在田野裡，請與反叛者配合。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... I really hate training ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
... 我真的討厭訓練...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
^4d4dffJulian^000000 is the person in charge of the operation here.
Please go and ask him.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff朱利安^000000是這裡行動的負責人。
請去問問他。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
They are like rats in a trap. All we have to do is the cleanup~ I'm going in, too.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們就像陷阱裡的老鼠。我們要做的只是收尾工作~ 我也要去。

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 很好，我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's natural.
You haven't found that thing you were looking for yet.
I will let you go. Could you just find that thing?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這是理所當然的。
你還沒找到你在找的那個東西。
我放你走。你能不能先找到那個東西？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As they occupied this place, they are remodeling some of the routes to make a training camp.
... Oh ... I hate it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他們佔領這裡後，正在改造部分路線，把它變成訓練營地。
... 噢... 我已經開始討厭了。

scripts.text: Enter the military base.
scripts.translation: 進入軍事基地

scripts.text: Good. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation: 很好，我指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh ... arg ...

[Rookie]
There are still come remnants inside the research facilities.
Actually ... they are more like monsters.
Anyway, take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
研究設施裡還有一些殘餘勢力。
實際上... 它們更像是魔物。
總之，保重。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The ^4d4dffcentral area^000000 seems to be located in this laboratory, ^4d4dffdeep inside the building's basement^000000.
Since we, the Rebellion, have completely occupied this place, please feel free to go there.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
^4d4dff中樞區域^000000似乎位於這個實驗室，^4d4dff在建築地下的深處^000000。
既然我們反叛者已經完全佔領了這裡，請隨意前往。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Teleport?
They cannot use it.
We have blocked it.
Actually, it's something we had never thought of ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
瞬間移動？
他們無法使用。
我們把它封鎖了。
實際上，這是我們從未想到的...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The man with shiny blonde hair told me to block magic related to movement as well.
Well, I know that the magic is more common in Rune Midgarts. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那個金髮閃閃發光的男子讓我把與移動相關的魔法也封鎖了。
嗯，我知道在魯恩米德加爾特，魔法是比較常見的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
After all, I hope you will find what you are looking for as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，希望你能儘快找到你在找的東西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Wow, welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哇，歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
I heard a loud sound inside the central room. I tried to get in there, but it had already been blocked.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
我聽到中樞室裡傳來巨大的聲響。我試圖進去，但那裡已經被封鎖了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Right. I was bounced out by an unknown force and could not defend the entrance until the end.
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的。我被一股未知的力量彈了出來，沒能守住入口直到最後。
我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
... What on earth was it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
...那到底是什麼東西？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
On my god ... Seyren Windsor?
And you've found it?
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
天哪...塞倫溫莎？
而且你找到了它？

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Then we must go back quickly.
Our mission is completed.
Let's go back to the hotel first.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亞]
那我們得快點回去。
我們的任務完成了。
先回旅館吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yeah. The rest of it is our task.
There are still plenty of monster experimental subjects inside, but
That's what we have to contend with.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的。剩下的事是我們的任務。
裡面還有很多魔物實驗體，
但那是我們必須應對的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Damn, go away!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
該死，滾開！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, I hate it here.
I want to go back to our hidout soon.
Shall we get out of here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
噢，我討厭這裡。
我想盡快回到我們的據點。
我們要離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hmm, are you the type of person who looks for trouble?
Well, we appreciate it if you help us clean up the remnants.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，你是那種喜歡找麻煩的人嗎？
好吧，如果你能幫我們清理這些殘餘勢力，我們會很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那就跟我來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Shall we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們現在離開嗎？

scripts.text: About the monster in the central room
scripts.translation: 關於中樞室的魔物

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Stay.
scripts.translation: 留下

scripts.text: About YSF01
scripts.translation: 關於YSF01

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Follow me, then.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那就跟我來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Since this fuss is likely to continue for a while, we'd be glad if you would stay here and help us~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然這場騷亂可能會持續一段時間，如果你能留在這裡幫助我們，我們將不勝感激~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why did Werner do that?
I don't understand.
... No. Maybe it's weird to understand a lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
維爾納為什麼要那樣做？
我不明白。
...不。也許理解一個瘋兔是很奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyways, We have to observe the central room's core.
As long as there are magic inside, the same thing will happen again.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
無論如何，我們必須觀察中樞室的核心。
只要裡面還有魔法，同樣的事情就會再次發生。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome.
Without any further ado,
We would like to hunt the ^4d4dffpet child^000000 guy. Will you join us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎。
不廢話了，
我們想獵殺那個^4d4dff小可愛^000000的傢伙。你願意加入我們嗎？

scripts.text: I am the pet child hunter!
scripts.translation: 我是小可愛獵人！

scripts.text: Reject!
scripts.translation: 拒絕！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, why?
It's just a monster!
We just have to kill it!
Then who should we ask to do it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，為什麼？
它只是一隻魔物！
我們只需要殺掉它！
那我們應該找誰來做這件事呢？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let's reveal its secret!
Let's find out why it keeps showing up!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
讓我們揭開它的秘密！
讓我們弄清楚它為什麼一直出現！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's in the central room. The place full of strange spirits in the middle of the central room.
Let me open the door for you first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
它在中樞室。中樞室中央那個充滿奇怪精靈的地方。
讓我先為您開啟門。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great! You're so cool!
Was it a replication of the former experimental subject? Self-replication?
They haven't found out the exact mechanism yet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
太棒了！您真酷！
它是之前實驗體的複製品嗎？自我複製？
他們還沒有發現確切的機制。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyhow, thank you for your support.
We will count on you again next time.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
無論如何，感謝您的支援。
下次我們還會依靠您。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The same monster is regenerated every single day. Isn't it a bit odd?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
同樣的魔物每天都會再生。這不是很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Maybe this guy is one of the objects that were split by transplanting the hearts of Ymir ...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
也許這傢伙是那些通過移植Ymir的心臟而被分裂出來的物體之一...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Anyway, let's see if that guy shows up again.
It's so~ interesting.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
總之，讓我們看看這傢伙是否還會再次出現。
這太~有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you call it a pet child?
Seems like they are completely leaving that guy to the adventurer
scripts.translation:
[新人]
您叫它小可愛？
看來他們完全把這傢伙交給冒險者處理了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you want, do not hesitate to tell me any time.
I will give you a mission to kill the pet child.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果您願意，請隨時告訴我。
我會給您一個獵殺小可愛的任務。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Do you want me to send you out of the operation zone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者隊員]
您想讓我把您送出行動區域嗎？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion squadder]
Well, good luck.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者隊員]
嗯，祝您好運。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... How many more facilities like this are there in Schwaltzvalt?
Haa ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
...施瓦茨瓦爾特還有多少像這樣的設施？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Fortunately, the letter seems to have arrived.
There is a reward that we prepared for you but we have not given it to you yet. So I sent this letter to invite you.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
幸運的是，信件似乎已經送達了。
我們為您準備了一份獎勵，但還沒有給您。所以我寄了這封信來邀請您。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
And our president said that his excellency would grant you enough compensation if you continue to help us get rid of the unwanted experimental subjects.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
而且我們的總裁說，如果您繼續幫助我們清除不需要的實驗體，他的閣下會給您足夠的補償。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As you helped our republic, his excellency is trying to get you some useful stuff for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
既然您幫助了我們的共和國，他的閣下正試圖為您弄一些對冒險者有用的東西。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The ^4d4dffSchwartz Honor Token^000000 that I am about to give you is a sort of reward currency used in the Rebellion as well.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我即將給您的^4d4dff施瓦茨榮譽徽章^000000是一種在反叛者中使用的獎勵貨幣。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since you are an adventurer, we thought it would be helpful for you.
You can exchange it for an item you need.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
既然您是一名冒險者，我們認為這對您會有幫助。
您可以用它交換您需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You may have received it already through the Rebellion.
Since this token is a prize for someone who did a job for Schwaltzvalt ...
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
您可能已經通過反叛者獲得過它了。
因為這種徽章是獎勵給為施瓦茨瓦爾特辦事的人的...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you want, you can receive them by continuing to help us.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
如果您願意，可以通過繼續幫助我們來獲得它們。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
So, we would like to give you simple requests or missions.
This kind of association is likely to continue for a while.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
所以，我們想給您一些簡單的請求或任務。
這種合作關係可能會持續一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
提前感謝您的支援。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since there are still some researchers hiding inside the laboratory, we plan to investigate it.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
由於實驗室裡仍有一些研究員在躲藏，我們計劃進行調查。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Please take charge of the investigation.
If you do this for us, we will give you the Schwartz Honor Token.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
請負責調查。
如果您為我們做了這件事，我們將給您施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Not now?
Then get some rest and come back please.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
現在不行嗎？
那就休息一下，再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Since we don't know where they are hiding, start looking in corners such as cabinets and boxes.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
由於我們不知道他們躲在哪裡，請從櫃子、箱子等角落開始尋找。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
After finding researchers, please hand them over to a Rebellion squad member near you.
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
找到研究員後，請把他們交給附近的反叛者小隊成員。
提前感謝您的支援。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Inside the laboratory, there are still some researchers hiding somewhere.
Please find them and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
實驗室裡仍有一些研究員躲在某個地方。
請找到他們，並交給反叛者小隊成員。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Thank you for your support in advance.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
提前感謝您的支援。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We already heard of your performance from the Rebellion.
Thank you for cooperating with the republic.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們已經從反叛者那裡聽到了您的表現。
感謝您與共和國的合作。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding. But we will find them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們突然襲擊了他們，預計還有更多人在躲藏。但我們遲早會找到他們的。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We attacked them all of a sudden, and we expect more of them are still hiding.
We will try to find those guys for now.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
我們突然襲擊了他們，預計還有更多人在躲藏。
我們現在會試著找到那些人。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If possible, I would ask you to investigate again.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
如果可能的話，我想請您再次調查。

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
.......
Then we cannot afford it.
... No, no.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
......
那我們負擔不起了。
...不，不。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
You're so cool, as usual.
Then could you please find the dregs hiding deep inside the laboratory and shaking like leaves?
I mean, the researchers.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
您一如既往地很酷。
那麼，請找到躲在實驗室深處、像樹葉一樣發抖的渣滓。
我是說，那些研究員。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
As usual, please find the researchers who are hiding and hand them over to a Rebellion squad member.
scripts.translation:
[泰絲]
一如既往，請找到躲藏的研究員，並交給反叛者小隊成員。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
No ... why did I volunteer for this?
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
不...我為什麼要自願做這個？

scripts.text: What's wrong with the Gunslinger?
scripts.translation: 神槍手怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Gunslinger is a place made by the Rebellion to train the upcoming generation, so they have a close relationship.
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
神槍手是反叛者建立的地方，用來訓練下一代，所以他們關係密切。

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
I heard that there was special training with the Rebellion so I volunteered. And what am I doing now?
I never imagined that I would be sent to this laboratory full of monsters!
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
聽說有反叛者的特別訓練，我就報名了。結果現在我在幹什麼？
我從來沒想過會被派到這個滿是魔物的實驗室！

scripts.text:
[Yudmil]
Arrrgh, especially Ms. Elena ... She makes us suffer ...
scripts.translation:
[尤德米爾]
啊...尤其是埃琳娜女士...她讓我們受盡了苦頭...

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續任務。-

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Inside the laboratory, there is pandemonium due to the experimental subjects that broke out.
Although we kill them, more of them come out from somewhere. I came out rest for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
實驗室裡因為實驗體逃脫而一片混亂。
雖然我們在擊殺它們，但不知從哪裡又不斷湧出來。我出來稍微休息一下。

scripts.text: Help him defeat Chimeras.
scripts.translation: 幫他擊敗凱美拉

scripts.text: Wish him good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝他好運

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Well ... Yeah. This is a part of training, too. Phew.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
嗯...是啊。這也是訓練的一部分。呼。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Then, please kill 10 of each
^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras^000000 and
^4d4dffHuman type Chimeras^000000
wandering around in the laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
那麼，請去消滅在實驗室裡遊蕩的
^4d4dff物質型凱美拉^000000和
^4d4dff人型凱美拉^000000
各10只！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Thanks to your support, we can pause for breath!
Cheer up, Adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
多虧了你的支援，我們可以喘口氣了！
加油，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Just defeat 10 of each type. That's all I ask.
They are ^4d4dffMaterial type Chimeras and Human type Chimeras.^000000
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
只要擊敗各10只就行了。這是我唯一的請求。
它們是^4d4dff物質型凱美拉和人型凱美拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
... The In Vivo Experiment is really horrible.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
...活體實驗真的非常可怕。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Wow, you did a great job for us!
Thank you.
Thanks to your support, we managed to get a good rest.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
哇，你幫了我們大忙！
謝謝。
多虧你的支援，我們得以好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Please be with us next time!
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
下次請繼續和我們在一起！

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Hey, thank you for your great job.
But there are still more monsters inside.
We are trying our best to get rid of them. But honestly, it's tough.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
嘿，謝謝你做得這麼好。
但裡面還有更多的魔物。
我們正在盡力清除它們。但說實話，這很難。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
Where do all of these experimental subjects come from?
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
這些實驗體都是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
They come out continuously. I can't imagine how many experiments they conducted.
I mean, Chimeras.
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
它們源源不斷地出現。我無法想像他們進行了多少次實驗。
我是說，凱美拉。

scripts.text:
[Yuslan]
I never imagined that Chimeras would be tougher than Heart Hunters ...
scripts.translation:
[尤斯蘭]
我從來沒想過凱美拉會比心之獵手更難對付...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't pick a fight with USU recklessly.
When people start fighting, I'll be the only one who feels annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不要魯莽地與USU挑起爭端。
一旦人們開始打架，只有我會感到厭煩。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Although I leashed them, they keep thinking about running out ...
Maybe their brains are filled with gunpowder. Silly weirdos.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雖然我把他們拴住了，但他們一直想著要跑出去...
也許他們的腦子裡裝滿了火藥。一群愚蠢的怪人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Cookie? I don't like sweets.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
綠餅人？我不喜歡甜食。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Lebedev guys baked it...
Then, I have no choice but to taste it. Give it to me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
列別捷夫那群人烤的...
那我別無選擇，只能嚐嚐了。給我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why are you empty-handed? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...你兩手空空？綠餅人呢？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
It smells good.
Seems like they gave a great effort. Tell them thanks.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
聞起來不錯。
看來他們很用心。替我謝謝他們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Wait, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
等等，你是誰？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I haven't seen you before.
You can't be in this place. Strangers like you are not supposed to be here.
^FF0000>>>Snap<<<^000000
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我從未見過你。
你不該出現在這裡。像你這樣的陌生人，本不該踏入此地。
^FF0000>>>弓身彈影<<<^000000

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Tell me exactly how you got here and where you came from unless you want to die.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
除非你想死，否則告訴我你是怎麼來到這裡的，以及你從哪裡來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am... You revealed you're an adventurer who came to help Secret Wings and requested cooperation to the Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是...你曾表明自己是一名冒險者，前來協助秘密之翼，並向反叛者尋求合作。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Secret Wings? They are just rookies. All they do is suck up to the president.
You're so brave. Who told you to visit me?
I don't want to dance to chicks flapping their wings. Just go away.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
秘密之翼？他們只是一群新人。整天只會向總裁拍馬屁。
你還真大膽。是誰讓你來見我的？
我可不想被那些扇動翅膀的小丫頭牽著鼻子走。滾開。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, wait please. In fact, I... no, my companion...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，請等一下。其實，我...不，是我的同伴...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Your companion saved Gonie?
...... So? You want a reward?
I really hate those who try to use other's lives as they please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你的同伴救了戈尼？
......所以呢？你想要獎勵？
我真的很討厭那些隨意拿別人的生命當籌碼的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well... I have a better idea.
Unlike the wimp chatting downstairs, you look quite interesting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...我有個更好的主意。
不像樓下那個只會瞎聊的膽小鬼，你看起來挺有趣的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You said you were just an adventurer, didn't you?
Great. If you defeat me in a fight, I will listen to your story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你說你只是個冒險者，對吧？
很好。如果你能在戰鬥中擊敗我，我就聽你說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
恕我直言？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Let's fight! I will listen to someone who fights me.
Talk to me when you are ready. Then I will let you enter the waiting room of the arena.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
讓我們打一架吧！我會聽與我交手之人的話。
當你準備好了，再來找我。屆時我會讓你進入競技場的候場室。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I fight you all of a sudden? Well, I don't feel like...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
突然就要和我打架？嗯，我並沒有那個意思...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you don't want to fight, I guess you don't need any cooperation. Go back.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果你不想打，看來你也不需要任何合作。回去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I'm in trouble. What shall I do?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（我陷入困境了。該怎麼辦？）

scripts.text: Fight Elena.
scripts.translation: 與埃琳娜戰鬥

scripts.text: I don't listen to someone weaker than me.
scripts.translation: 我不聽弱者說話

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(I have no choice. Let's prepare for the fight and talk to Elena Volkova again.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（別無選擇。準備戰鬥，再次與埃琳娜·沃爾科娃交談。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't listen to someone weaker than m...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不聽弱者說話...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm? I misheard something. Haha, could you repeat it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯？我好像聽錯了。哈哈，能請你再說一遍嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... I'll do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...我會做的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. Tell me when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。準備好了就告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你準備好了嗎？
我們現在去候場室嗎？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候場室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
在候場室，有負責競技場入場事務的^0000CD伊萬^000000。
請按照伊萬的指引，依序進入競技場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你有兩分鐘時間。如果你能在兩分鐘內擊敗我，你就贏了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果在戰鬥中你想投降，請告訴伊萬旁邊的^0000CD索麗塔^000000。
然後你就會受到斥責。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... By the way, are you really going to fight me?
I am an expert in killing people. And fighting is not your main occupation. You cannot beat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...順便問一下，你真的要和我戰鬥嗎？
我是殺人專家。而戰鬥並不是你的主業。你贏不了我的。

scripts.text: But I will fight.
scripts.translation: 但我還是要戰鬥

scripts.text: I agree with you. I give up.
scripts.translation: 我同意你的看法。我放棄

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. Knowing one's limit is wise.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。知難而退是明智的。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're a cleric. Fighting is not your duty. I'm sure your companion also knows that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你是牧師。戰鬥不是你的職責。我相信你的同伴也明白這一點。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Besides, you're just an adventurer. You have no business with us and those guys either. I'm afraid you might get hurt.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
況且，你只是個冒險者。你和我們，以及那些人沒有任何關係。恐怕你會受傷。

scripts.text: No, I will fight.
scripts.translation: 不，我要戰鬥

scripts.text: ...I think you're right. I give up.
scripts.translation: ...你說得對。我放棄

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. You don't have to get hurt yourself being nosy.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。多管閒事只會讓自己受傷。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You must a fool who doesn't know what's going on.
Do you think I'm kidding? Or your life is too heavy and you'd like to put everything down?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你一定是個不知道發生了什麼事的傻瓜。
你以為我在開玩笑嗎？還是說你的命太沉重，你想放下這一切？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is the final warning. You stay out of this.
Tell the guy downstairs that you had no choice because I intimidated you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這是最後的警告。你最好離這件事遠點。
告訴樓下的那個人，說你別無選擇，是因為我威脅了你。

scripts.text: This is my problem too.
scripts.translation: 這也是我的問題。

scripts.text: Since I don't want to die, I give up.
scripts.translation: 既然不想死，我就放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Life is important, especially when it's mine.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。生命很重要，尤其是我的命。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Why is this your problem?
That talkative guy is a stooge of the President. But you're an adventurer who can just leave.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...為什麼這是你的問題？
那個話多的人是總統的走狗。但你只是個可以隨意離開的冒險者。

scripts.text: This is the problem of those who trust me.
scripts.translation: 這是信任我的人的問題。

scripts.text: I guess I'd better go.
scripts.translation: 我想我還是走吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're wise. Enjoy your adventure in a safer place.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你很明智。去更安全的地方享受你的冒險吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, well, well.
Haha, you are so obstinate.
I like your spirit. You said you need a cooperation? Why not? I agree.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。
哈哈，你真是固執。
我喜歡你的精神。你說你需要合作？為什麼不呢？我同意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Pardon?!

[USU commander Elena]
You said you needed my approval to persuade us. So I approve it.
I like spunky fellows. It's fun to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你說你需要我的批准來說服我們。所以我批准了。
我喜歡有衝勁的人。和他們戰鬥很有趣。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ah, don't misunderstand it. I'm not saying I will fight you. I'm saying that I will be on your side.
I didn't mean to fight you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
啊，別誤會。我不是說我要和你戰鬥。我是說我會站在你這邊。
我本來就沒打算和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't mess with clerics. I don't feel good after fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不跟牧師打交道。和他們打完架我會感覺不好。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I'll support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
所以我會支援與秘密之翼的合作。你需要我的簽名嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不需要。下次請在別人面前表明你的立場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
No problem.
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
沒問題。
既然你現在是我們的合作者，去四處看看有沒有人有問題。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
誰知道呢？如果你一直幫助他們，他們可能會對你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雖然我們從未忘記必須復仇的血債，但我們也不忘感恩。
如果你幫助他們，他們會給你一個證明你榮譽的信物。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
就像我現在給你的這個一樣。
如果你想知道這是做什麼用的，去樓梯下面問問那個叫“斯特拉瑟”的固執傢伙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation between the Secret Wings and Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我戰鬥嗎？
你不是來這裡請求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。我會在這裡等你。
等你準備好戰鬥時再告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
一個害怕我的膽小鬼，對反叛者沒有任何幫助。
滾開。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Hmm. So this is it.
If you want to fight me again, I will give you another chance.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
... 嗯。原來如此。
如果你想再和我打一次，我會再給你一次機會。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 進入候場室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不進入候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great. You have guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender during a fight, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。你很有膽量。
伊萬會帶你進去。
如果在戰鬥中想投降，就告訴索麗塔。
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Haven't you come here to ask for the cooperation with the Rebellion?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我戰鬥嗎？
你不是來這裡請求秘密之翼和反叛者合作的嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. I will wait for you.
Tell me when you feel like fighting.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。我會在這裡等你。
等你準備好戰鬥時再告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
A coward who's scared at me won't be helpful for the Rebellion at all.
Get lost.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
一個害怕我的膽小鬼，對反叛者沒有任何幫助。
滾開。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! I lost.
My feeling was right. It was such a thrilling fight after a long time!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈！我輸了。
我的直覺沒錯。真是久違的酣暢淋漓的戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I promised, I will listen to you. Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如我所承諾的，我會聽你說。請講。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So she's listening to me now. Persuading her will be much more difficult.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（她現在願意聽我說話了。想要說服她恐怕會更難。）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I have come to request a cooperation between the Secret Wings and the Rebellion.
In order to persuade the people of Rebellions, I would like to ask you for help...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我來請求秘密之翼與反叛者之間的合作。
為了說服反叛者的人，我想請你幫個忙...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Okay. I will help you.
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好的。我會幫你的。
我該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pardon? You haven't heard my story yet...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉？你還沒聽我講完故事呢...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You don't have to tell me the story. You've already told me the story physically. If I can fight on the same side with you, I will welcome whatever it is.
So I support the cooperation with the Secret Wings. Do you need my signature?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你不必告訴我故事。你已經用拳頭告訴我了。如果我能和你並肩作戰，無論是什麼我都歡迎。
所以我支援與秘密之翼的合作。需要我簽字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, you don't have to. Please show your opinion in front of others next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，不需要。下次請在別人面前表明你的立場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. ...... By the way,
If you have time, visit the arena any time.
I will fight you even if you come every day.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。...... 順便說一下，
如果你有時間，隨時可以來競技場。
即使你每天都來，我也願意和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since you are our cooperator now, go around and see if there is anyone who has any problem.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
既然你現在是我們的合作者了，去四處看看，有沒有誰遇到了麻煩。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Who knows? If you keep helping them, they might have good feeling about you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
誰知道呢？如果你一直幫助他們，他們可能會對你有好感。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
While we never forget the blood that we must take a revenge for, we do not forget the gratitude either.
If you help them, they will give you a token proving your honor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雖然我們從未忘記必須復仇的血債，但我們也不忘感恩。
如果你幫助他們，他們會給你一個證明你榮譽的信物。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Just like the one I'm giving you now.
If you want to know what this is for, ask the stubborn guy named 'Strasse' below the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
就像我現在給你的這個一樣。
如果你想知道這是做什麼用的，去樓梯下面問問那個叫“斯特拉瑟”的固執傢伙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
Have you met our members?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗨。怎麼了？
你見過我們的成員了嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hi. What is it now?
A fight? Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗨。怎麼了？
打架？歡迎！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
Are you sure you have to fight me now?
If you really think so, come back tomorrow. I called it a day now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。
你確定現在就要和我打嗎？
如果你真的這麼想，明天再來吧。我今天已經收工了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...... Hmm.
No. Not now.
I would like to fight you when you are in the top condition. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...... 嗯。
不。不是現在。
我想在你狀態最好的時候和你打。明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, great!
Tell me when you are fully ready. I will go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哦，太好了！
等你完全準備好了告訴我。我會去休息室等著。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm...?
I told you. I don't fight clerics.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...？
我告訴過你。我不打牧師。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would like to fight you! Please allow me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想和你打！請允許我！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Oh, every time I beat the hell out of a cleric, I become quite unlucky on that day. It's true.
So I'd rather not fight a cleric...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哦，每次我把牧師打得落花流水，那天就會變得很不走運。這是真的。
所以我寧願不打牧師...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
............

[USU commander Elena]
...Huh, look at your eyes. I have no choice but to fight you.
But I will ^0000CDgo very easy on^000000 you. Don't make drama after you defeat me.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
... 呵，看看你的眼神。我別無選擇，只能和你打了。
但我^0000CD會手下留情的^000000。別在我輸給你之後搞什麼戲劇性的一齣。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you ready?
Shall we go to the waiting room now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你準備好了嗎？
我們現在去候場室嗎？

scripts.text: Go to the waiting room
scripts.translation: 去候場室

scripts.text: Don't go to the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不去候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In the waiting room, there is ^0000CDIvan, the person in charge of entrance in arena^000000.
Enter the arena according to the order in reference to Ivan's guide.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
在候場室，有負責競技場入場事務的^0000CD伊萬^000000。
請按照伊萬的指引，依序進入競技場。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You have two minutes. If you defeat me during two minutes, you win.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你有兩分鐘時間。如果你能在兩分鐘內擊敗我，你就贏了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you want to surrender during the fight, tell ^0000CDSorita^000000 beside Ivan.
Then you're going to be told off.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果在戰鬥中你想投降，請告訴伊萬旁邊的^0000CD索麗塔^000000。
然後你就會受到斥責。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Aren't you going to fight me?
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你不打算和我打嗎？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Will you give up the fight?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你要放棄戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好，我會等著的。
我很享受和你戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, you don't have to do this... You're so persistent.
Well, I remember I told you that I like it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我告訴過你，你不必這樣做的... 你真是執著。
好吧，我記得我說過我喜歡這樣。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...You made me expect it. And what are you doing now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
... 你讓我期待了。那你現在在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good idea. You'll be quite sad if you are beat up without having done anything wrong. Won't you?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好主意。如果你沒做錯事卻被揍了一頓，肯定會很難過吧？不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't you think you've had enough of it by now? If you want to quit, tell me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你覺得你受夠了嗎？如果你想退出，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Hmm. You're not in a top condition?
If you want to do this again, welcome.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
... 嗯。你狀態不好？
如果你想再試一次，歡迎。

scripts.text: Enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 進入候場室

scripts.text: Do not enter the waiting room.
scripts.translation: 不進入候場室

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ho, you have the guts.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
呵，你有膽量。
伊萬會帶你進去。
如果你想投降，告訴索麗塔。
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I like it.
Ivan will guide you inside.
If you want to surrender, tell Sorita.
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我喜歡。
伊萬會帶你進去。
如果你想投降，告訴索麗塔。
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition? Go inside and take some rest.
Shall we stop?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你狀態不好？進去休息一下吧。
我們要停止嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You're not in a top condition?
Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你狀態不好？
照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me feel sorry for you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
別讓我為你感到難過。

scripts.text: Give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 放棄戰鬥

scripts.text: Do not give up the fight.
scripts.translation: 不，繼續戰鬥

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hey, you don't have to do this...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嘿，你不必這樣做的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Great, I will be waiting.
I enjoy fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好，我會等著的。
我很享受和你戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Right. Let's stop the fight.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好吧。我們停止戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...We have no choice. Come back later.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...我們別無選擇。稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I told you that I'd ^0000CDgo easy on you^000000. Although won the fight, you didn't actually win it. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我說過會^0000CD手下留情^000000的。雖然你贏了這場戰鬥，但實際上你並沒有贏。明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...Being mean is not my character. This is why I don't want to be entangled with clerics...
Hey, pronounce the benediction for me before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...刻薄不是我的性格。這就是為什麼我不想和牧師糾纏不清...
嘿，離開前給我施個祝福吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hahaha, great fight!
What a pity. I wanted to win today...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈，精彩的戰鬥！
真可惜。我今天本想贏的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm glad that you are becoming stronger.
I can see the result of steady training.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很高興看到你變得更強了。
我能看出你刻苦訓練的成果。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Come back. I can fight you everyday.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
回來吧。我隨時都可以和你打。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good.
Enjoy it while you can.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那很好。
趁現在好好享受吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Not busy? That's good news.
Apart from fighting... I would like to ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
不忙？那是好訊息。
除了戰鬥...我想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I'm not sure if I can say this to an outsider... But you are close to the Rebellion now.
Will you keep the secret?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不確定能不能對外人說出這些...但你現在和反叛者很親近。
你會保守秘密嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意。

scripts.text: It will be difficult.
scripts.translation: 這會很困難。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Then I can't tell you.
Forget what I've said.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...那我不能告訴你。
忘掉我剛才說的話。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Yes. Make sure you keep the secret.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
是的。務必保守秘密。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Good. First of all... do you know about USU that I am commanding?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
很好。首先...你知道我指揮的USU嗎？

scripts.text: Superior... unit?
scripts.translation: 超級...單位？

scripts.text: Isn't it where you isolated problem children?
scripts.translation: 不是用來隔離問題兒童的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... No. It's not true.
It's actually the opposite.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...不。那不是真的。
實際上恰恰相反。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... What?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...什麼？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha... Kaka. Right. You know very well about it.
But don't say that in front of the troops. They might shoot you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈...卡卡。沒錯。你很清楚那是怎麼回事。
但別在部隊面前這麼說。他們可能會開槍打你。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
USU stands for ^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000. It's a group of weirdos who did some crazy things.
Since they had done great job for the Rebellion, we isolate them with lead on their neck rather than death penalty or discharging.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
USU代表^0000CDUnder Seal Unit^000000。這是一群做過瘋狂事情的怪人。
因為他們為反叛者立下過汗馬功勞，所以我們沒有處死或開除他們，而是讓他們戴著鉛項圈被隔離起來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
As I told you, it's a unit outside our regulation. So I can't tell you about it in detail. But we do several things that Rebellions don't do.
You can imagine all you want, including murder or violence. It will be worse than that.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
正如我所說的，這是一個不受常規管轄的單位。所以我不能詳細告訴你。但我們做了一些反叛者不做的事情。
你可以隨意想像，包括謀殺或暴力。實際情況會比那更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But we still have a absolute rule. We don't mess up with other Rebellions.
Although we let them do whatever they want outside, we teach them who's holding their lead.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
但我們有一條絕對規則。我們不會去招惹其他反叛者。
雖然我們在外面允許他們為所欲為，但我們教會他們是誰在掌控著他們的鉛項圈。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And there are new members... ^0000CDJana Levedeva^000000 and ^0000CDIlya Lebedev^000000. They are twins and still young.
Although they are young, their ability is outstanding. The problem is that they are out of control.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
還有新成員... ^0000CD雅娜·列別傑娃^000000和^0000CD伊利亞·列別捷夫^000000。他們是雙胞胎，而且年紀還小。
雖然年幼，但他們的能力非常出色。問題在於他們無法控制自己。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
They skip the training and hurt a squadder by causing an accident during training... Recently, they tried to run away from the unit and got caught. So the duty manager and I had a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他們逃課，還在訓練中製造事故傷害了一名斯誇德... 最近，他們試圖逃離單位被抓了回來。這讓值班管理員和我都很頭疼。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
According to the regulation, we have to discharge them.
... But they are still under age. According to the commander of their former unit, they don't have parents.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
根據規定，我們必須開除他們。
...但他們還未成年。據他們原單位的指揮官說，他們沒有父母。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If we kick out these guys, they might become hooligans. At the worst, they will be involved in crime.
It sounds funny that I'm saying this as a commander of USU...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果我們把這些傢伙趕出去，他們可能會變成流氓。最壞的情況是，他們會捲入犯罪。
作為USU的指揮官，我說這話聽起來可能有點諷刺...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
At least I don't want to see kids disgracing themselves.
But by looking at what they are doing, they will live as animals with lead in USU at best.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
至少我不想看到孩子們自暴自棄。
但看他們的所作所為，在USU裡戴著鉛項圈像野獸一樣生活，已經是最好的結果了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
... Maybe they are already regarding me as an enemy. So they won't listen to me.
I know how to make them listen to me. But it will only make the situation worse.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...也許他們已經把我視為敵人了。所以他們不聽我的。
我知道怎麼讓他們聽話。但那隻會讓情況變得更糟。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So I request you to check their problem and solve it, adventurer.
If they don't say anything, ask other fellows around them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
所以，我請求你去調查他們的問題並解決它，冒險者。
如果他們什麼都不說，就去問問他們周圍的人。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: I will help.
scripts.translation: 我會幫忙。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I don't want to demand you to do this.
It's a problem inside our unit. So we'd better handle ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不想強迫你這樣做。
這是我們單位內部的問題。所以我們最好自己處理。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Forget what I told you.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
忘掉我告訴你的事吧。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Thanks.
^0000CDYana and Ilya twins^000000 are in the lobby.
They have bright silver hairs and they're always together. You'll find them easily.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
謝謝。
^0000CD雅娜和伊利亞雙胞胎^000000在大廳裡。
他們有著亮銀色的頭髮，而且總是形影不離。你很容易就能找到他們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
In case you don't get any outcome after talking to them, talk to other fellows.
The mess personnel... and another fellow in the outside store seems to want to say something.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果你和他們交談後沒有任何結果，就去問問其他人。
食堂的工作人員...還有外面商店裡的另一個人似乎想說什麼。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, you talked to them?
Hmm, not yet...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
那麼，你跟他們談過了嗎？
嗯，還沒...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You are the only one I can trust now.
I'll count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
現在你是唯一我能信任的人。
我就指望你了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Did you talk to them?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你跟他們談過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
If you cannot judge it easily, you can talk to ^0000CDother fellows around them^000000.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
如果你無法輕易判斷，可以去問問^0000CD他們周圍的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So, how is it going?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
那麼，進展如何？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Hmm... Not at all?
I though they might open their mind to a stranger. But I was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
嗯...完全不行嗎？
我以為他們或許會對陌生人敞開心扉。但我錯了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
...There's someone you should talk to lastly.
I didn't want to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
...最後還有一個人你需要去談談。
我並不想這樣做。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Go downstairs and find ^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000. He must be nearby the fireplace.
He's middle-aged man... and a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
去樓下找^0000CD埃裡克松·阿德勒，他是分隊的指揮官^000000。他應該在壁爐附近。
他是個中年男子...也是雙胞胎的前上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since the guys have been assigned to my unit, I wanted to take care of them here. But they're not helping us.
If I ask Adler about the guys, it won't look so good. That's why I am requesting you. Please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
既然那傢伙被分配到了我的部隊，我想在這裡照顧好他們。但他們並沒有幫助我們。
如果我直接問阿德勒關於那傢伙的事，情況會顯得很不妙。所以我才請求你幫忙。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
^0000CDEricsson Adler, commander of a detached force^000000 must be nearby the fireplace.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
^0000CD埃裡克松·阿德勒，分隊的指揮官^000000應該在壁爐附近。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
He's a former boss of the twins.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
他是雙胞胎的前上司。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
How's it going on now?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
現在情況怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: You told Elena Volkova what Lebedev twins told you.
scripts.translation: 你告訴了埃琳娜·沃爾科娃列別捷夫雙胞胎告訴你的話。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So... That was the reason.
I had already heard about that accident.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
原來...那是原因。
我已經聽說過那次事故了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But I had no idea they were feeling such a burden.
Since they were out of control... there was no way for me to recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
但我沒想到他們會揹負這麼大的壓力。
因為他們當時失控了...我沒有辦法察覺到這一點。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Well, they're still kids after all. Since they have great ability, Me and other squadders treated them as adults.
We should not have done it...
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
好吧，畢竟他們還只是孩子。因為他們很有天賦，我和其他斯誇德隊員就把他們當作大人對待了。
我們不該那樣做的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
And I should have talked to Adler beforehand.
Thanks, {0}. You helped me so much.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
而且我應該事先和阿德勒談談的。
謝謝你，{0}。你幫了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I guess I have to tell them something anyway.
Will you help me once again? Tell them that I'm looking for them. And you come with them please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我想我無論如何都得跟他們說點什麼。
你能再幫一次忙嗎？告訴他們我在找他們。請和他們一起回來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
The twins will be nearby the place where they've always been.
Tell them about me and come back with them.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雙胞胎應該在他們常待的地方附近。
告訴他們我的情況，然後帶他們回來。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
So you're all here? I've heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們都在嗎？我已經聽說了整件事的經過。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
是的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Yes...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
......是的...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev! Attention!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列別傑娃和伊利亞·列別捷夫！立正！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you insane? You ran away from the unit for a private reason. And you hurt your companion!
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們瘋了嗎？為了私事擅自離開部隊。還傷害了你們的同伴！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This may look like a mercenary group like a piece of garbage. But we deal with people's life. We have disciplines that you must abide by.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這看起來可能像是一群像垃圾一樣的傭兵。但我們處理的是人們的生命。我們有你們必須遵守的紀律。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
......

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......We're sorry...
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
......對不起...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
But before I scold you about it...
I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
但在責備你們之前...
我要先道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
I didn't know that you had been forced so much and could not consider it. And I wasn't there for counseling even though I was your boss.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
我不知道你們承受了這麼大的壓力，以至於無法考慮周全。而且，儘管我是你們的上級，卻沒有在你們需要時提供諮詢。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
This is totally my fault and my mistake.
I apologize. You had a rough time of it.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
這完全是我的責任和錯誤。
我很抱歉。你們經歷了一段艱難的時光。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
......No, no... We have to apologize.
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
......不，不... 是我們該道歉。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
From now on, I will pay more attention to you.
Would you please try to make sure this never happens again?
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
從現在開始，我會更加關注你們。
請你們也試著確保這種情況不再發生，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...No... We are the ones who should apologize.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
...不... 是我們該道歉。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It will never happen again...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
這種事絕不會再發生了...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Since this is a military group, you have regulations to abide by.
But since you are minors, I would like to give you an opportunity to grow as much as possible.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
既然這是一個軍事團體，你們必須遵守規章制度。
但考慮到你們還是未成年人，我希望給你們一個儘可能成長的機會。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Jana Levedeva and Ilya Lebedev. I will exclude you from the real fight for some time.
Instead, feel free to do the works that you can do inside the unit.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
雅娜·列別傑娃和伊利亞·列別捷夫。我會暫時將你們排除在實際戰鬥之外。
相反，請隨意在部隊內部做你們能做的事情。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
You can make new friends, start a hobby or enhance your shooting ability. You can even do things that I cannot expect.
Do what you want to do. Make sure you abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你們可以結交新朋友，培養愛好，或者提升射擊能力。甚至可以做我意想不到的事情。
做你們想做的事，但務必遵守規章制度。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
So we're... not being kicked out?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
所以... 我們不會被開除嗎？

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Don't make me say it twice. I told you I was responsible for what happened.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
別讓我說第二遍。我告訴過你們，我對發生的事負責。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Oh... Thank you so much!
And... Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
哦... 太感謝您了！
還有... 對不起。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Thank you, commander...!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
謝謝您，指揮官...

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
That's all about it. You can go back now. There's something I'd like to discuss with the adventurer.
And if you need anything, talk to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
事情就是這樣。你們可以回去了。我有件事想和冒險者談談。
如果你們需要任何幫助，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lebedev twins]
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[列別捷夫雙胞胎]
是！

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Phew...
Great job, {0}.
Thanks to your support and concern, we managed to do this.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
呼...
幹得好，{0}。
多虧了您的支援和關心，我們才能做到這一點。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Ha... I told them to do what they want. And they will wonder what to do for a while.
For those guys to do what they want, they'll need your help again.
Please help them at that time.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈... 我讓他們做想做的事。他們可能會有一段時間不知道該做什麼。
對於那兩個孩子來說，要做想做的事，還需要您的幫助。
到時候請幫幫他們。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
......Thanks.
I will count on you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
......謝謝。
今後就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Are you taking care of them well?
Wow, I am relieved that they have a babysitter now.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
你照顧他們得不錯嘛？
哇，既然有人當保姆，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[USU commander Elena]
Haha! Just kidding. Thank you for your support. You're so reliable.
Take care of the guys please.
scripts.translation:
[USU指揮官 埃琳娜]
哈哈！開玩笑的。感謝你的支援，你真可靠。
請好好照顧那群傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What is it now?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索裡塔]
怎麼又怎麼了？

scripts.text: I want to go out.
scripts.translation: 我想出去。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Do not talk to me when you have nothing to say.
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索裡塔]
沒事別跟我說話。

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
What are you talking about? So you're telling me you would like to run away without fighting? Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索裡塔]
你在說什麼？你是想不戰而逃嗎？不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
You must be kidding. What kind of nonsense is this! Why did you come here in the first place and annoy me?
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索裡塔]
你開什麼玩笑。這是什麼胡話！你一開始來這裡就是為了煩我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tough Guy Sorita]
Dang, I have been quite upset after the commander gave me this useless work. And you make me even more upset. Get the hell out of here!
scripts.translation:
[硬漢 索裡塔]
該死，指揮官給我派了這種沒用的工作，我已經夠煩了。你還讓我更煩。滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你迷路了，去樓下問問別人。
他們會告訴你怎麼出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you are lost, go downstairs and talk to the others.
They will let you know how to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你迷路了，去樓下問問其他人。
他們會告訴你怎麼出去。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hey, you two there!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
嘿，你們兩個！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes!!! Yep!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
是！！！好的！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Escort this adventurer safely downstairs.
Seems like he has lost his way.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
把這個冒險者安全地送到樓下。
看來他迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Yes! I will!!!!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
是！我會的！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
And if by any chance...... Well, I guess you already know that part. I will hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果萬一...... 嗯，我想你已經知道那部分了。我會把它交給你。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Oh.. Yes Sir!
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
哦.. 遵命，長官！

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
請跟我來，這邊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!

[Rebellion leader]
Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
還有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Tell the leader about having saved Gonie.
scripts.translation: 告訴首領你救了戈尼

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Oh!
I see!
Thank you so much for helping our youngster.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哦！
我明白了！
非常感謝你幫助我們的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Hmm.. As I expected......
Gonie......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
嗯...果然不出所料......
戈尼......

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
The one who went to Einbroch not long ago......
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
就是不久前去了艾音布羅克的那個人......

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ah!
That guy?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
啊！
那個人？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Haha!
This fellow is full of chivalry! It's difficult to find people like this nowadays.
Normally they just pass by......
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哈哈！
這傢伙真是充滿俠義精神！現在像這樣的人很難找了。
通常他們只會路過......

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Especially after finding that he was wearing a Rebellion suit.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
尤其是發現他穿著反叛者的制服後。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
By looking at your eyes, I see you haven't come to hear gratitude from us.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
看著你的眼睛，我知道你來這裡不是為了聽我們的感謝。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
The man called Lazy who came with you...
He's been wandering around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
和你一起來的那個叫懶散的傢伙...
他一直在這一帶徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You helped Gonie by chance. But you didn't come here by chance. Did you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
你救戈尼是出於偶然。但你來這裡絕不是偶然的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
You'd better think twice before you answer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
回答之前最好三思。

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 談談合作

scripts.text: Go back.
scripts.translation: 回去

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Be careful on your way home.
The public order is not so good in this area.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
回家路上小心。
這一帶治安不太好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Help?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
幫助？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Ha...
I think you are misunderstanding something.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
哈...
我想你誤會了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Surely, I want to express my gratitude for what you did for Gonie.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
當然，我想對你為戈尼所做的一切表示感謝。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
But!
What you are saying now is a totally different issue.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
但是！
你現在說的是完全不同的事情。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
秘密之翼？
哈！別讓我笑！
你現在提這個，說明你知道我們和他們之間的關係，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你不這麼做，那就意味著你只是在被利用。既然如此，你就該識趣地離開了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
這就是我能告訴你的全部了。
請現在離開。

scripts.text:
[Young Rebellion]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的反叛者]
請跟我來，這邊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Leave the adventurer alone.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
別管那個冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
He must know his position better than anyone else.
The man called Lazy, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
他肯定比任何人都清楚自己的處境。
那個叫“懶散”的傢伙也是。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
Secret Wings?
Ha! Don't make me laugh!
The fact you say it now shows that you know something about the relationship between us and them. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
秘密之翼？
哈！別讓我笑！
你現在提這個，說明你知道我們和他們之間的關係，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
If you don't, that means you are just being exploited. Then you just have to go back gently.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
如果你不這麼做，那就意味著你只是在被利用。既然如此，你就該識趣地離開了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader]
This is all I can tell you.
Please leave now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領]
這就是我能告訴你的全部了。
請現在離開。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What is it?
Are you still here?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼事？
你還在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
If I didn't see a ghost, you are living a pretty long life. Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
如果我沒看錯的話，你活得可真夠長的。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Guard leader!
Good that you're here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊！
衛隊長！
你來得正好。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Take this fellow out, now.
I thought you would leave on your own, if you cared for your life. But you are still hanging around here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
現在就把這傢伙帶走。
我以為你要是惜命的話，早就自己走了。沒想到你還賴在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's so annoying to see this rat wandering around in my space.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
看到這隻老鼠在我的地盤上亂竄，真是令人厭煩。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
There's something more important now. Here's a letter from Dien.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
現在有更重要的事情。這是迪恩寄來的信件。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
A letter from Dien?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
迪恩的信件？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yes. Here it is...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
是的。給您...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's quite unusual to receive a letter from her.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
收到她的信，還真是稀罕事。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me see... I agree. Do you agree, too?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
讓我看看...我同意。你也同意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm?
Agree with what?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
嗯？
同意什麼？

scripts.text: Talk about cooperation.
scripts.translation: 談談合作

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm..........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
嗯..........

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長...
我想我剛才看到了幽靈。你想看看這封信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
啊？
是的！大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Hmm.........
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
嗯.........

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader...
I think I have seen a phantom. Would you like to read it?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長...
我想我剛才看到了幽靈。你想看看這封信嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Yeah?
Yes! Sir!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
啊？
是的！大人！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
The commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼？
指揮官？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What the hell... Is that jerk still alive after sending this letter to the commander?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
該死……那個混蛋給指揮官寄了信之後居然還活著？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What did the commander say?
He is not the type of a man who would just sit down after listening to it. Is he?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
指揮官說了什麼？
他可不是那種聽了之後就會坐視不管的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Erst agrees with it, too.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
厄斯特也同意這個看法。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ha!
This is nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
哈！
真是胡扯。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我無法接受。
我不知道你對他們做了什麼。但我還要再跟他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
迪恩在哪裡？
在房間裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你不用進來，魯伯特。
外面太吵了，所以我出來了。原來是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
I cannot accept this.
I don't know what you did to them. But I will talk to them again.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我無法接受。
我不知道你對他們做了什麼。但我還要再跟他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
Where is Dien?
In the room?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
迪恩在哪裡？
在房間裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You don't have to come in, Rupert.
It was so noisy outside, so I came out. It was you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你不用進來，魯伯特。
外面太吵了，所以我出來了。原來是你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Guard leader!
What are you doing!
Escort Dien to the room.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
衛隊長！
你在幹什麼！
把迪恩護送回房間。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You and I just do not appear to communicate.
I didn't know you were so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
看來我們倆就是沒法好好溝通。
沒想到你竟然這麼固執……

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
It's all because of you, Dien.
I still remember you telling me a story about them. You were so angry with them. Now you make this choice.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
都是因為你，迪恩。
我還記得你跟我講過關於他們的事。當時你對他們那麼生氣。現在你卻做出了這樣的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
As you put on years, your memory and judgment are not as good as they used to be.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
隨著年歲增長，你的記憶和判斷力都不如從前了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What!
What have you just said!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
什麼！
你剛才說了什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
At that time, you were just an infant in diapers. How do you happen to know so much about them?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
那時候你還只是個穿尿布的嬰兒。你怎麼會對他們的事這麼清楚？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Did you experience that incident yourself?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
難道你親身經歷過那場變故？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
I'm the one who saved your life during the ravage of war.
And just look at your big mouth now!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
是我在戰亂中救了你一命。
看看你現在這副嘴臉！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Is it the way I taught you?
Come on, say that again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
是我教你的嗎？
來，再重複一遍！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
What the hell are you doing!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊……！！
你在幹什麼！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Just release your hold.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
放開手。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien! Please calm down!
You shouldn't do this here!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
迪恩！請冷靜一下！
你不該在這裡這麼做！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You just shut up!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你給我閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Ha...
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
哈……

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Whatever you say, I'm against it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
不管你說什麼，我都反對！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
You are still chattering with the big mouth!
Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你這張大嘴還在喋喋不休！
不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrggh!!!
Come on, it hurts!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊……！！
喂，很痛！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
What are you doing! They are all looking at you!!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
你在幹什麼！大家都在看著你！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Well, I don't care who's looking at me.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
哼，我才不在乎誰在看我。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
What have you done so far with that vengeance alone?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你光靠復仇，到現在為止做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Are you going to hate them forever, doing nothing until I die?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
難道你要一直恨他們，什麼都不做，直到我死為止嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
How many years do you think I have ahead!!!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
你覺得我還能活多少年！！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
By looking at you now, I'm sure you can live for 100 more years!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
看你現在的樣子，我敢肯定你還能再活100年！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Great!
Let me live for 100 more years and pull out your beard!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
太好了！
讓我再活100年，把你的鬍子拔光！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Arrgh!!!!
Stop it!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊……！！
住手！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Ah!
Okay! I got it!
Do as you wish!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
啊！
好！我知道了！
隨你便！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
給你。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
But you will to have to face the consequences. Be prepared!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
但你必須承擔後果。做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
That's exactly what I was hoping for.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
這正是我所希望的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
No...
Guard leader!
Tell each senior and commander to gather now.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
不……
衛隊長！
通知所有前輩和指揮官，立刻集合。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
讓我說清楚。
我們會幫你。但別指望得到太多幫助。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我們沒有理由為你做出犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Hey! You are saying this again!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
嘿！你又說這種話了！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Since you got the approval from Rupert, {0} why don't you go back for report?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
既然魯伯特已經批准了，{0}，你回去彙報一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
It seems like the youngsters will be busy for a while. Please help the old people, whenever you have time.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
看來年輕人們要忙一陣子了。有空的時候，請多關照我們這些老人家。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion senior Dien]
Ah!! Rupert!
Talk to me before the meeting.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者前輩 迪恩]
啊！魯伯特！
開會前跟我談談。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Let me make this clear.
We will help you. But don't expect too much help.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
讓我說清楚。
我們會幫你。但別指望得到太多幫助。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
There is no reason why we have to sacrifice for you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
我們沒有理由為你做出犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
I read it, too. What you have said just now was written there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
我也讀了。你剛才說的話，信裡都寫了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
The same thing was written in the letter that I handed to Erst.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
我交給厄斯特的那封信裡，寫的也是同樣的內容。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion Guard leader Larcis]
Dien!
It's dangerous outside. There are outsiders there.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者衛隊長 拉西斯]
迪恩！
外面很危險。有外人。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's alright. Larcis.
They are not so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
沒事的，拉西斯。
他們沒那麼危險。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion leader Rupert]
Dien!
I was about to visit you.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者首領 魯伯特]
迪恩！
我正要去找你。
