她應該沒走遠。您能在艾音貝赫幫我找找慈善嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
These Anchovy cookies are Charity's favorite snack. Put the cookies on ^0000CDbenches in various places of the village^000000 and call Charity. If she comes out, please bring her to me.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
這些鯷魚餅乾是慈善最愛的零食。請把餅乾放在^0000CD村莊各處的長椅上^000000，然後呼喚慈善。如果她出來了，請把她帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
If she doesn't come out... You can go somewhere else to find her. Maybe she cannot hear you at once. In that case, put Anchovy cookies on the bench and call Charity again.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
如果她沒出來...您可以去別的地方找找她。也許她一時沒聽到。那樣的話，就在長椅上放鯷魚餅乾，再呼喚一次慈善。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
I have to prepare the meal for gluttons... Could you go bring Charity?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
我得準備給大胃王們做飯...能麻煩您去把慈善帶回來嗎？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Charity... You're getting late. I hope nothing happened to you.
I'm sure people will stop her from rushing to the train of entering the mine. Right?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
慈善...你回來得有點晚。希望你沒遇到什麼事。
我相信大家會攔住她，不讓她急著去坐進礦車的。對吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey! Please say yes. Am I right? People like you will protect her, won't they?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
嘿！請說“是”。我說得對嗎？像你們這樣的人會保護她的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thank you! I will give you enough Anchovy cookies.
They are for cats. Give them to Charity and bring back the rest of them. Make sure you don't eat them.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
謝謝！我會給你足夠的鯷魚餅乾。
那是給貓吃的。把它們給慈善，剩下的帶回來。千萬別自己吃了。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops? You've come back in empty hands. Where are your Anchovy cookies? Have you run out of them already?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哎呀？你空手回來了。你的鯷魚餅乾呢？已經吃完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...Don't tell me you ate them all.
I never thought that you'd actually eat them. Did you eat them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
...別告訴我你全吃了。
我沒想到你真的會吃。你吃了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, I'm kidding. Did Charity steal them from you? She's so fast and she can do that.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哦，我開玩笑的。是慈善從你那裡偷走的嗎？她動作很快，完全做得到。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Anyway, I'll give you the Anchovy cookies again. Please keep them safe. This time, you return with Charity and Anchovy cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
總之，我再給你一些鯷魚餅乾。請保管好。這次，你要帶著慈善和鯷魚餅乾一起回來！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Have you found Charity? If she doesn't show up, call her several times on the same spot.
Who knows? She might be afraid of you because you are a stranger. Charity is a smart cat. Show her that you are harmless.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
你找到慈善了嗎？如果她沒出現，就在同一個地方多呼喚幾次。
誰知道呢？她可能因為你是陌生人而害怕。慈善是一隻聰明的貓。向她展示你是無害的。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hmm... It's been a while since Charity went out...
But not such a long time for us to worry about her.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
嗯...慈善出去已經有一會兒了...
但還沒到讓我們擔心的程度。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
To tell the truth!! I want to see Charity!! I want to pet her!! I miss her so much!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
說實話！！我想見慈善！！我想摸摸她！！我好想她！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...So, let me give you Anchovy cookies again. Please find Charity.
Put them on ^0000CDVillage Bench^000000 in Einbech and call Charity. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
...所以，我再給你一些鯷魚餅乾。請找到慈善。
把它們放在艾音貝赫的^0000CD村莊長椅^000000上，然後呼喚慈善。你願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 幫助他。

scripts.text: Don't help him.
scripts.translation: 不幫他

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Charity... Charity...
Arrgh... Charity... I hope they write on my tombstone that I died while missing Charity so much...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
慈善...慈善...
啊...慈善...我希望我的墓碑上寫著，我是因為太想念慈善而死的...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Please, adventurer... Will you write it on it? Please say yes...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
拜託了，冒險者...你能把它寫上去嗎？請說“是”...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thanks! Go and get her please.
Oh... I'm suffering from withdrawal symptoms... Charity... I should pet her as soon as possible to recover...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
謝謝！快去把她帶回來吧。
啊...我好像戒斷反應發作了...慈善...我得儘快摸摸她才能恢復...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Use the Anchovy cookies to find Charity and bring the rest of them!
Make sure you don't eat them. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
用鯷魚餅乾找到慈善，並把剩下的帶回來！
千萬別自己吃了。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oops? You've come back in empty hands. Where are your Anchovy cookies? Have you run out of them already?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哎呀？你空手回來了。你的鯷魚餅乾呢？已經吃完了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
...Don't tell me you ate them all.
I never thought that you'd actually eat them. Did you eat them?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
...別告訴我你全吃了。
我沒想到你真的會吃。你吃了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh, I'm kidding. Did Charity steal them from you? Phew, she is too fast...
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哦，我開玩笑的。是慈善從你那裡偷走的嗎？呼，她動作真快...

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Anyway, I'll give you the Anchovy cookies again. Please keep them safe. This time, you return with Charity and Anchovy cookies!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
總之，我再給你一些鯷魚餅乾。請保管好。這次，你要帶著慈善和鯷魚餅乾一起回來！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Have you found Charity? If she doesn't show up, call her several times on the same spot.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
你找到慈善了嗎？如果她還沒出現，就在原地多叫幾聲她的名字。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh . . . ! !
Charity! I'm so glad you are all right! Look at her soft hairs! Charity!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哦……！！
慈善！太好了，你沒事！看看這柔軟的毛髮！慈善！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who brought her and he doesn't seem to care about me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我把她帶回來的，他卻好像完全不在意我……

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Miss Charity! You must have been exhausted after being brought by this dusty adventurer.. Shall I prepare the bathwater? Or your meal first? Or... Can I pet you first?!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
慈善小姐！被這個滿身灰塵的冒險者帶回來，你一定累壞了吧……
我先去準備洗澡水？還是先準備飯菜？或者……能讓我先摸摸你嗎？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are they doing this on purpose?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們這是故意的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Oh . . . ! !
Miss Charity! I'm glad you are all right! You are beautiful as usual, Charity!!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
哦……！！
慈善小姐！太好了，你沒事！你依然那麼美麗，慈善！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who brought her and he doesn't seem to care about me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我把她帶回來的，他卻好像完全不在意我……

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Miss Charity! You must have been exhausted after being brought by this dusty adventurer.. Shall I prepare the bathwater? Or... Can I pet you first?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
慈善小姐！被這個滿身灰塵的冒險者帶回來，你一定累壞了吧……
我先去準備洗澡水？或者……能讓我先摸摸你嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess that's the way they live.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來這就是他們的生活方式吧。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Hey, she's quite mean.
...... What a cat.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
嘿，她脾氣真差。
……真是一隻貓。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You didn't have a meal? As far as I know, every creature including humans and cats become aggressive when they are hungry~
Do you want a warm meal? Well, I cannot guarantee the taste.
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
你沒吃飯嗎？據我所知，無論是人類還是貓，餓肚子的時候都會變得暴躁~
想吃點熱乎的飯菜嗎？雖然我不能保證味道有多好。

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
You brought it as you promised! A {0} of {1}. Will you give it to me now?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
你如約帶來了！{1}的{0}。現在可以給我了嗎？

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Do not give it to him.
scripts.translation: 不給他

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Well, I see. Although you are an adventurer, they are not easy to get. Aren't they?
All I can get around this place {0}. I can't make anything nice with them.
It's just a lack of my ability, haha!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
原來如此。雖然你是冒險者，但這些東西並不容易弄到，不是嗎？
我在這附近只能弄到{0}。用它們做不出什麼好吃的東西。
只是我手藝太差了，哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
It looks delicious! Thank you for your kindness!
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
看起來很好吃！謝謝你的好意！

scripts.text:
[Milo River]
Thank you so much for making our seniors happy!
I have to prepare for the tea time tomorrow as well... If you don't mind, could you bring it again tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[米洛·裡弗]
非常感謝你讓前輩們開心！
我還得為明天的下午茶做準備……如果不介意的話，明天能再帶一些來嗎？

scripts.text: No more Anchovy cookie. Let's go back to Milo and get some more.
scripts.translation: 鯷魚餅乾沒有了。回米洛那裡再拿一些吧。

scripts.text: It's an empty bench. Take out several Anchovy cookies and...
scripts.translation: 這是一張空長椅。拿出幾塊鯷魚餅乾，然後……

scripts.text: Put them on the bench.
scripts.translation: 放在長椅上

scripts.text: Eat them.
scripts.translation: 吃掉它們

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yuck! This is so fishy. What kind of food is this...!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呸！這味道好腥啊。這是什麼食物...!!

scripts.text: But nothing happened.
scripts.translation: 但是什麼也沒發生。

scripts.text:
After waiting for a while, you reclaimed the Anchovy cookies.
Go to another bench or wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
等待了一會兒後，你拿回了鯷魚餅乾。
請去另一張長椅，或者再等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Charity]
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[慈善]
喵~

scripts.text:
Charity is here!
You lured her with the Anchovy cookie and held her.
scripts.translation:
慈善來了！
你用鯷魚餅乾引誘了她，並抓住了她。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I'm charge of repairing here. The supply is handled there.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我負責這裡的維修工作。那邊的物資由那裡負責。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Firearms are actually consumables. If someone shoots them, someone has to maintain them.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
火器其實也是消耗品。有人射擊，就有人需要維護。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Cookies? Where did you get them? Aha... Made by Lebedev kids?
Well. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
餅乾？你在哪裡弄到的？啊...是列別傑夫家的小孩做的嗎？
嗯。謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm? Where is the cookie?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯？餅乾在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Smells nice... I will ask them the recipe later.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
聞起來不錯...我稍後問問他們配方。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Again? If you broke your weapon and are pretending that you lost it, don't even think about it.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
又來？如果你把武器弄壞了，卻假裝是弄丟了，那就別想了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
...... Oops? Oh, sorry. Who are you?
I had three guys today who lied to me that they lost their weapons after breaking them. So I thought you would probably say the same thing.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
......哎呀？哦，抱歉。你是誰？
今天已經有三個人騙我說他們弄丟了武器，其實是因為弄壞了。所以我以為你大概也會這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Aha, you are an advanturer.
Come to think of it, you must be that adventurer who had a sparring with commander Elena of USU. You're so brave.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
啊，你是冒險者。
仔細想想，你一定是那位曾與USU指揮官埃琳娜切磋過的冒險者。你真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I'm Rachel Smith. I'm a Blacksmith and I assist repairing weapons and maintenance.
Would you like to show me your weapon? By looking at many weapon, I can study them.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我是瑞秋·史密斯。我是一名鐵匠，協助武器維修和維護。
你想給我看看你的武器嗎？通過觀察許多武器，我可以研究它們。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm... This is a nice weapon. You ran it in properly.
It's interesting. Although they are same weapons, they have different tendencies according to what the owner focuses on.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯...這是一把好武器。你保養得很好。
很有趣。雖然它們是同一種武器，但根據使用者關注的重點不同，也會表現出不同的特性。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
... But it doesn't happen to the weapons that I repaired. I don't know why.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
...但我維修的武器不會這樣。我不知道為什麼。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Oh, sorry. I'm worried about something recently. Those weapons I have repaired lately have a high defect rate.
The people are struggling in the field because of that.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
哦，抱歉。我最近有點擔心。我最近維修的武器故障率很高。
人們因此在戰場上很吃力。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Fortunately, nothing bad has happened so far. But I'm so nervous.
Every night I have a nightmare in which the weapon explodes in the hands of our squadders...
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
幸運的是，目前還沒有發生不好的事情。但我非常緊張。
每晚我都會做噩夢，夢見武器在斯誇德手中爆炸...

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Although I'm not an expert yet, I would like to solve the problems without worrying the Master or squadders.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
雖然我還不是專家，但我希望在不讓師父或斯誇德擔心的情況下解決這些問題。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hey adventurer. Could you please do me a favor?
Could you show the weapon that I repaired to Blacksmith guild and ask them for some advice?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嘿，冒險者。能幫我個忙嗎？
你能把我維修的武器帶到鐵匠公會，請他們給點建議嗎？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Oh... I see.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
哦...我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you for your help. I can count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
謝謝你的幫助。我可以指望你。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If the weapon repaired by me hurts our people, and not the enemy, it will be a tragedy. I would like to prevent that from happening.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果我維修的武器傷害了同伴而不是敵人，那將是一場悲劇。我想阻止這種情況發生。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Bring this revolver to Einbroch Blacksmith guild and show it to them. Since I am a member of that guild, they will recognize it when they see the revolver repaired by me. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
請把這把左輪手槍帶到艾音布羅克的鐵匠公會，給他們看看。因為我是該公會的成員，他們看到我維修的左輪手槍就會認出來的。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm... Where is my revolver?
This is irresponsible. I will give you another gun. Don't do this again.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯……我的左輪手槍在哪裡？
這太不負責任了。我會再給你一把槍。不要再這樣了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Bring my gun to Einbroch Blacksmith guild and show it to them. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
請把我的槍帶到艾音布羅克的鐵匠公會，給他們看看。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Welcome back. What did they say?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
歡迎回來。他們怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
So... it's the material. Hmm...
As a matter of fact, I estimated it a little.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
原來……是材料的問題。嗯……
說實話，我確實估算了一下。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
But I had no other choice. Due to the lack of budget, I could not get better materials.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
但我別無選擇。由於預算不足，我無法獲得更好的材料。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Moreover, our Master brilliantly repairs weapons with these materials. But I keep breaking them..
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
而且，我們的師父用這些材料能出色地維修武器。但我總是把它們弄壞……

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
So I was trying to improve it by myself. But I changed my mind after listening to you.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
所以我原本想自己改進它。但聽了你的話後，我改變了主意。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
My mistake is not only mine. It can also put every squadder in danger. Everyone's safety is more important than my personal pride.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我的錯誤不僅是我個人的問題，還可能讓每個斯誇德成員陷入危險。大家的安全比我的個人自尊更重要。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Therefore.. Adventurer, I would like to ask you for a favor. Could you please bring me the materials that I require?
Whenever you think of it... Once a day would be perfect. If you bring them occasionally, it's also good.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
因此……冒險者，我想請你幫個忙。你能幫我帶些我需要的材料嗎？
只要你想起來……每天一次就很好。如果你偶爾帶一些來，也沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I cannot give you money for that. But I will compensate you with something else. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我不能為此付錢給你。但我可以用別的東西作為補償。你覺得如何？

scripts.text: Grant her favor.
scripts.translation: 答應她的請求

scripts.text: Reject her favor.
scripts.translation: 拒絕她的請求

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you, adventurer.
Hmm... The most important item is.. Let me see. Today.. I need some Iron.
Five Iron. Could you please bring them to me?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
謝謝你，冒險者。
嗯……最重要的物品是……讓我看看。今天……我需要一些鐵。
五塊鐵。你能幫我帶過來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Yes. I will.
I have no other choice.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
是的。我會的。
我別無選擇。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
I think I can sort it out with the Ore that you have brought.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我想用你帶來的礦石就能解決。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If you can help me again... Could you come back tomorrow? I might need other Ore.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果你能再幫我一次……明天能再來嗎？我可能需要其他礦石。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Welcome, adventurer. Thanks to your help last time, I was able to work without difficulty.
Is it okay if I ask you for a favor again?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
歡迎，冒險者。多虧了你上次的幫助，我工作起來很順利。
我可以再請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: Of course it's okay.
scripts.translation: 當然可以

scripts.text: I am busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天很忙。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Hmm.. I see. But thank you for your help last time.
Thank you coming again.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯……我明白了。不過還是要感謝上次的幫助。
謝謝你再次前來。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Apart from the materials...
Can you come here to meet me once in a while?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
除了材料之外……
你能偶爾來這裡看看我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
To enhance the gun barrel, I need Oridecon.
Please bring me two Oridecon.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
為了強化槍管，我需要神之金屬。
請給我帶兩塊神之金屬。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Today I don't have enough Elunium. Could you please bring me two Elunium?
I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
今天我的鋁不夠了。能請你帶兩塊鋁來嗎？
就拜託你了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Iron is the most basic material for every weapon. Without it, I cannot do anything only with other enhancing materials.
So please bring me five Iron
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
鐵是所有武器最基礎的材料。沒有它，光靠其他強化材料我什麼都做不了。
所以請給我帶五塊鐵。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
If the gun barrel is not hard enough, the inner barrel will be melt after several shots. After all, it will be worn out soon.
To prevent it, we need high quality Oridecon. Please bring two.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
如果槍管不夠堅硬，打幾發之後內壁就會熔化。總之很快就會磨損。
為了防止這種情況，我們需要高品質的神之金屬。請帶兩塊來。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
The blacksmiths in large cities exchange Elunium Ore with Elunium... Please bring me two Elunium.
If I had a better skill, it would have been enough with Ore. I'm ashamed...
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
大城市裡的鐵匠會用鋁礦石交換鋁……請給我帶兩塊鋁。
如果我的技術再好一點，用礦石就夠了。真慚愧……

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
We always don't have enough Iron. Bring five Iron please.
Thank you so much, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
我們的鐵總是不夠用。請帶五塊鐵來。
非常感謝你，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
You have brought {0} {1} that I asked you for? Thank you very much!
Are you sure you are giving them to me?
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
你帶來了我要的{0} {1}？非常感謝！
你確定要給我嗎？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: Sorry. I need it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我需要用。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Yeah. I am just requesting you.
If you have more important thing to do, don't worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
嗯。我只是在請求你而已。
如果你有更要緊的事，別為我擔心。

scripts.text:
[Rachel Smith]
Thank you, adventurer...
Although I cannot give you money, let me give you this.
If possible, I would like to ask you for a favor tomorrow too.
scripts.translation:
[瑞秋·史密斯]
謝謝你，冒險者……
雖然我不能給你錢，但請收下這個。
如果方便的話，明天還想再拜託你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Seems like you are looking for someone. What is it?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
看來你在找什麼人。怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An advice for repairing weapons? Well, but you are not a Blacksmith, are you?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
關於修理武器的建議？嗯，不過你並不是鐵匠，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Oh, you have come here after being requested by the member of our guild. Let me see it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
哦，你是被我們公會的成員拜託才來的吧。讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Come on. I have to look at the weapon to give you an advice.
I am a Blacksmith, not a psychic.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
快拿來。我得看看武器才能給你建議。
我是鐵匠，又不是心靈感應者。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Hmm. This is definitely the skill of our guild member. She has developed the method we taught her.
Her skill is good. Hmm, but...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
嗯。這絕對是出自我們公會成員之手。她發展出了我們教給她的方法。
她的技術不錯。嗯，但是……

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is... Hmm, I see...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
這是……嗯，我明白了……

scripts.text: Jack is scrutinizing Rachel's revolver.
scripts.translation: 傑克正在仔細檢查瑞切爾左輪手槍。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
This is not a matter of her skill. It's the materials.
Since there are so many impurities mixed in the metal, it mush have been hard for her to handle this. But she barely did it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
這不是她技術的問題，而是材料的問題。
金屬裡混雜了太多雜質，她處理起來一定很吃力。但她還是勉強完成了。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her she must use the metal with higher purity.
This is not the problem of someone who handles it. I won't be surprised if it exploded while she was repairing it.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
回去告訴她，必須使用純度更高的金屬。
這不是操作者的問題。如果她在修理時它爆炸了，我也不會感到驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
Go back and tell her. It might be exploded in the meantime...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
快回去告訴她。說不定到時候它已經爆炸了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
An experienced Blacksmith can recognize the status of the weapon just by feeling the vibration on the arm when he/she smashes that weapon with a hammer.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
經驗豐富的鐵匠，僅憑用錘子敲擊武器時手臂感受到的震動，就能判斷武器的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Jack]
In addition to that, The real master must check it with eyes and ears as well.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 傑克]
除此之外，真正的大師還需要用眼睛和耳朵去檢查。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
This is delicious. No mission yet?
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
真好吃。還沒有任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Yeah. They told me to stand by.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
是啊。他們讓我待命。

scripts.text:
[Danae]
Oh, I'm waiting for my off-duty day. I will go to Yuno to eat something delicious.
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
哦，我在等我的休息日。我要去尤諾吃點好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh, it was so hard. Wasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
哦，那一定很艱難吧？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
Not that hard. Did I tell you the story when I went to Hermes Fletue?
scripts.translation:
[方]
沒那麼難。我跟你講過我去赫爾墨斯·弗勒特的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yes, you did. More than thousand times.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
講過，你講過。而且講了一千多遍。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I told you not to drink the tea while you are holding the gun. What if you spill it on it?
scripts.translation:
[方]
我告訴過你，拿著槍的時候不要喝茶。萬一灑在上面怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Yeah, I will finish drinking first.
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
是啊，我會先喝完的。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
Why do you keep wiping it?
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
你為什麼一直在擦拭它？

scripts.text:
[Danae]
I always have to take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[達娜厄]
我總是得照顧它。

scripts.text:
[Tommy]
You're so diligent.
scripts.translation:
[湯米]
你真勤快。

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I'm so tired. I will sleep after drinking a cup of tea.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我好累。喝完這杯茶我就去睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
You said No.1 priority is reporting and No.2 is the gun, after the mission. Didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
你說過，任務結束後，第一優先是彙報，第二優先是槍，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fang]
I will do it after sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[方]
我睡醒後再做。

scripts.text:
[Grinder]
Oh? You once told me I must die after those No.1 and No.2 jobs!
scripts.translation:
[研磨工]
哦？你以前還告訴我，做完第一和第二優先的事之後，我就得去死了！

scripts.text:
[Fang]
That's only for newbies. Not for me.
scripts.translation:
[方]
那只是對新人的要求，對我可不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
Ah, I'm so hungry. Nothing happened during my patrol today.
scripts.translation:
[本]
啊，好餓。今天巡邏的時候什麼事都沒發生。

scripts.text:
[Ben]
What was for the dinner?
scripts.translation:
[本]
晚飯吃什麼？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
I love reading books during my night duty. Where is the episode 3?
scripts.translation:
[馬克曼]
我喜歡在值夜班的時候看書。第三集在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Markman]
Rookie! Where is the episode 3? Rookie! Rookie!!
scripts.translation:
[馬克曼]
新人！第三集在哪裡？新人！新人！！

scripts.text:
[Tott]
Night fishing is the best fishing of all. The sound of water, small light and the feeling of being alone at night.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
夜釣是釣魚中最好的體驗。水聲、微光，還有夜晚獨處的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Tott]
So I come out here quite often. The water is so dirty here that there is no fish here. I just enjoy the feeling.
scripts.translation:
[托特]
所以我經常來這裡。這裡的水太髒了，沒有魚。我只是享受這種感覺。

scripts.text:
[Maymay]
Oh, I have to finish this.... zzzz
scripts.translation:
[梅梅]
哦，我得把這個做完... zzzz

scripts.text:
[Corona]
This light, so beautiful. It's perfect!
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
這光，真美。太完美了！

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Look at this. Isn't this light beautiful? It's glanced on the lamp.
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
看這個。這光美不美？它反射在燈上了。

scripts.text:
[Corona]
Ha.. This is perfect. I will wipe it more so that there will be more brilliant light.
scripts.translation:
[科羅娜]
哈... 這太完美了。我要再擦一擦，讓光更亮。

scripts.text: Seems like you have too many belongings. Let's try it again after you remove some.
scripts.translation: 看起來你的物品太多了。請移除一些物品後再試一次。

scripts.text: Your belongings are too heavy. Let's try it again after you reduce the weight.
scripts.translation: 你的物品太重了。請減輕重量後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
A customer? I wasn't going to do business today. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
顧客？我今天不打算做生意。我太累了。

scripts.text: I heard similar words somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡聽過類似的話

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
It's just your imagination. There is no one like me in the world.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
那是你的錯覺。世界上沒有像我這樣的人。

scripts.text: ^0000ffBut he still looks familiar.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff但他看起來還是很熟悉。^000000

scripts.text: It's a waste of time
scripts.translation: 浪費時間

scripts.text: Tell me what you sell
scripts.translation: 告訴我你賣什麼

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Huh, go away.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哼，走開。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Schwartz Honor Token, an item issued by the nation and whose transaction between individuals is prohibited. I take those items from people and upgrade their gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
施瓦茨榮譽徽章，是國家發行的物品，禁止個人之間進行交易。我從別人那裡收走這些徽章，然後升級他們的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
After betraying a rival in the same field, I got the secret method of upgrading. Since then, I have been working in the shadows like this ... Oh, forget it. This is not a pleasant story.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
背叛了同領域的競爭對手後，我掌握了升級的秘密方法。從那以後，我就一直像這樣在暗處活動... 算了，這不是什麼愉快的故事。

scripts.text: (He DOES look familiar ...)
scripts.translation: (他確實看起來很熟悉...)

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Anyway, if you have bunch of tokens and do not just throw them away, visit me. We can make a good trade.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
總之，如果你有一堆徽章又不想直接扔掉，就來找我吧。我們可以做一筆好交易。

scripts.text: What kind of trade?
scripts.translation: 什麼交易？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I provide a special upgrade for Agenda Robes, Consultation Robes and Mercenary Rings type A and B. In return, I take Schwartz Honor Tokens.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我為議程外袍、商事外袍以及傭兵之戒A型和B型提供特殊升級。作為回報，我會收取施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Well, I don't have to continue nagging like this. Just bring me the tokens when there is gear that you would like to upgrade. Then we can talk about the trade in detail.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
好了，我不必再囉嗦了。當你有想要升級的裝備時，帶著徽章來找我。到時候我們再詳細談談交易細節。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Have you come for the trade? Tell me what you need.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你是來做交易的嗎？告訴我你需要什麼。

scripts.text: Tell me the terms of the trade
scripts.translation: 告訴我交易條款

scripts.text: Upgrade my robe
scripts.translation: 升級我的外袍

scripts.text: Upgrade my ring
scripts.translation: 升級我的戒指

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my robe
scripts.translation: 重置我外袍的升級容量等級

scripts.text: Initialize the upgraded capacity level of my ring
scripts.translation: 重置我戒指的升級容量等級

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen. I won't say it twice.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著。我只說一次。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I take 20 Schwartz Honor Token to upgrade the slot of an Agenda Robe or Consultation Robe. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 Schwartz Honor Token for initialization. Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級議程外袍或商事外袍的一個插槽需要20枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。升級的最大插槽數為2。重置則需要10枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。你明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Then it's Mercenary Ring type A and B. I take five tokens for upgrading a slot. The maximum slots for the upgrade are two. And I will take 10 tokens for initialization.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
然後是傭兵之戒A型和B型。升級一個插槽需要5枚徽章。升級的最大插槽數為2。重置則需要10枚徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
The initialization cannot be conducted at any time. I will only do it after you are granted two effects and cannot upgrade the gear any more. And ... then ...
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
重置不能隨時進行。只有在你獲得兩個效果且無法再升級裝備後，我才會進行重置。而且... 然後...

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
There is a slight problem. Mercenary Ring type A and B might be destroyed during the initialization. The probability is about 20 percent. Since they are small items, there are serious side effects when eliminating the upgraded effect.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
有個小問題。傭兵之戒A型和B型在重置過程中可能會損壞。機率大約是20%。由於它們是小物品，消除升級效果時會有嚴重的副作用。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I look forward to having a good business relationship with you, fellow.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
期待與你建立良好的商業關係，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
For the Consultation Robe and Agenda Robe, you need 20 Schwartz Honor Tokens for each slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
對於商事外袍和議程外袍，每個插槽需要20枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。你確定要升級嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後別跟我閒聊了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你正在卸下裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your gear, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嘿，認真點。如果你想升級裝備，必須先正確穿戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
這件裝備無法再升級了。你還有其他事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。如果你沒有{0}，就無法與我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，做得不錯。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need five Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade a slot of Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot. Are you sure you want to upgrade it?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級佩戴在左側插槽的傭兵之戒A型或B型的一個插槽，需要5枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。你確定要升級嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後別跟我閒聊了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only upgrade accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me upgrade it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我忘了告訴你。我只升級佩戴在左側插槽的飾品。請先將其佩戴在左側插槽，然後讓我升級。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hey, grow up. If you want to upgrade your Mercenary Ring, you must put it on properly first.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嘿，認真點。如果你想升級傭兵之戒，必須先正確穿戴好。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
No more upgrade is possible on this gear. Do you have anything else?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
這件裝備無法再升級了。你還有其他事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。如果你沒有{0}，就無法與我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，做得不錯。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
To initialize the Consultation Robe or Agenda Robe, you need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens. The gear itself will not be destroyed. The card you already inserted and its smelting level will be safe as well.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
重置商事外袍或議程外袍需要10枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。裝備本身不會被破壞。已插入的卡片及其精煉等級也會保留。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後別跟我閒聊了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You are taking off your gear.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
你正在卸下裝備。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件物品尚未完全升級。目前無法進行重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件物品尚未完全升級。目前無法進行重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。如果你沒有{0}，就無法與我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，做得不錯。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
You need 10 Schwartz Honor Tokens to upgrade Mercenary Ring type A and B equipped on your left slot.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
升級佩戴在左側插槽的傭兵之戒A型或B型，需要10枚施瓦茨榮譽徽章。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
As I explained before, the initialization of rings is quite hard. ^ff0000The success rate is 80 percent.^000000 If it fails, the item is gone. Are you sure you want to do this?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
正如我之前解釋的，戒指的重置相當困難。^ff0000成功率為80%。^000000如果失敗，物品將會消失。你確定要這樣做嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Let's do it
scripts.translation: 就這麼辦

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Since I am busy, do not talk to me pointlessly from now on.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我很忙，以後別跟我閒聊了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I am telling you in advance. Every time you initialize the ring, there is a 20 percent probability of destruction. Are you sure you want to continue?
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我提前告訴你。每次重置戒指，都有20%的機率導致物品損毀。你確定要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Yes. Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
是的。好主意。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
I forgot to tell you something. I only initialize accessories equipped on the left slot. Equip it on your left slot first and then let me initialize it.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
我忘了告訴你。我只重置佩戴在左側插槽的飾品。請先將其佩戴在左側插槽，然後讓我重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件物品尚未完全升級。目前無法進行重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Whoops, this item has not been fully upgraded. The initialization is not possible yet.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
哎呀，這件物品尚未完全升級。目前無法進行重置。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Listen, fellow. If you don't have any {0}, you cannot trade with me.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
聽著，夥計。如果你沒有{0}，就無法與我交易。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Oh, you are unlucky today. Your gear has been badly damaged.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
噢，你今天運氣不好。你的裝備嚴重損壞了。

scripts.text:
[Hogar]
Hmm, it's been done well. Check your item.
scripts.translation:
[霍加爾]
嗯，做得不錯。檢查一下你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Butterfly Merchant]
... ... ... ... ...
Do you need {0}?

[Imperial Operator]
Hello.
We have ^4d4dffImperial^000000 equipment that can be exchanged for {0}.
I will guide you to exchange items according to your job.
scripts.translation:
[帝國操作員]
你好。
我們有可以用{0}兌換的^4d4dff帝國^000000裝備。
我會根據你的職業引導你進行物品兌換。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包太重了。
請整理一下，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You have too much in your inventory.
Please make it lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的背包太重了。
請整理一下，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hello. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你好。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Hmm... You don't have any Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Please come back after taking care of other tasks.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
嗯...你沒有黑森林榮譽徽章。
請先處理其他事務，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Oh, you brought the Schwartz Honor Tokens.
I always thank you for your help.
We have to show you our gratitude in return.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
哦，你帶來了黑森林榮譽徽章。
我一直很感謝你的幫助。
我們必須向你表達我們的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
For our cooperators who brought certain amount of tokens, we will grant gifts. Please choose items you require.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
對於帶來一定數量徽章的合作者，我們將贈送禮物。請選擇你需要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Which one would you like to select?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你想選擇哪一個？

scripts.text: Agenda Robe
scripts.translation: 議程外袍

scripts.text: Consultation Robe
scripts.translation: 商事外袍

scripts.text: Costume Combat Vestige
scripts.translation: (時裝)血戰之痕

scripts.text: Hat of Republic
scripts.translation: 共和國之帽

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring A type
scripts.translation: 傭兵戒指 A型

scripts.text: Mercenary Ring B type
scripts.translation: 傭兵戒指 B型

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
{0}? I got it.
You need {1} Schwartz Honor Tokens.
Are you sure you want this?
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
{0}？明白了。
你需要{1}個黑森林榮譽徽章。
你確定要這個嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Please come back after you decided.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
請決定好後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
You don't have enough tokens...
Please collect some more.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
你的徽章不夠...
請再收集一些。

scripts.text:
[Strasse]
Here is your {0}.
scripts.translation:
[斯特拉瑟]
這是你的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Rotten]
Ah, I hate cleaning. Why don't they develop a machine that does the cleaning automatically?
scripts.translation:
[腐朽]
啊，我討厭打掃。為什麼他們不發明一種能自動打掃的機器呢？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have too many items in your inventory. Why don't you come back after making it lighter? It looks too heavy.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你背包裡的物品太多了。為什麼不整理輕裝後再來呢？看起來太重了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Authorized Personnel Only. Stay away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
僅限授權人員進入。請離開。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, please take a good rest today. You must take of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
冒險者，今天請好好休息。你必須照顧好自己。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I will see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
明天見。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back, adventurer. Did you have a good rest mentally and physically?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎回來，冒險者。你休息得還好嗎？身心都恢復了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Last night, many weapons were not returned. I really have to teach these guys some lesson...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
昨晚，很多武器都沒有歸還。我真的得好好教訓一下這些人...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Anyway, I will count on you. ^0000cdGo down from Einbech and find Suspicious Heap of Earth^000000 and investigate it. Then ^0000cdbring about three broken guns^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
總之，就拜託你了。^0000cd從艾音貝赫下去，找到可疑的土堆^000000並調查一下。然後請^0000cd帶回大約三支損壞的槍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Ha........... There are so many guys who did not return their weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哈........... 居然有這麼多傢伙沒有歸還武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome, adventurer. You came back earlier than we expected. Didn't the Grudges attack you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎，冒險者。你回來得比我們要預期的早。怨靈沒有攻擊你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
So you've brought what I told you? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
所以你已經帶回了我要的東西？讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring ^0000cdthree Broken Gun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯.. 不夠。我讓你帶^0000cd三支損壞的槍^000000回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
^0000cdGo down from Einbech^000000 and investigate ^0000cdSuspicious Heap of earth^000000 in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
^0000cd從艾音貝赫下去^000000，調查幾處^0000cd可疑的土堆^000000。在那裡你可以找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
既然有怨靈，我知道這並不容易。但我們還是指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你帶回了足夠多的損壞的槍。但我們無法使用它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我想你至少需要搜尋五個土堆，並擊敗大約五個怨靈。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我知道你為了給我們帶回這些武器很努力。抱歉又要麻煩你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
My god... It's amazing. You've reclaimed all these weapons in that short time. They've been hiding so many weapons everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
天哪... 太不可思議了。你在這麼短的時間內收回了所有這些武器。他們把這麼多武器藏在了各個地方。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Adventurer, you must be tired today. Take a rest and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000 tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
冒險者，你今天一定很累。休息一下，明天^0000cd黎明^000000後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello? can I take a look around?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好？我可以四處看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh, you are the famous adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦，你就是那位著名的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What am I famous for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我因為什麼而著名？

scripts.text:
[Master]
They say we had an outsider after a long time. And the outsider persuaded us to cooperate with the government.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
聽說很久以來我們這裡第一次有外人到來。而且這位外人說服我們與政府合作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I haven't done so much.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有做那麼多。

scripts.text:
[Master]
But that's what I heard.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
但我聽到的就是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, what is this place? Since there are so many guns, I guess this is an armory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便問一下，這是什麼地方？既然有這麼多槍，我猜這裡是個軍械庫。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sort of. We lend weapons for Rebellions here.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
差不多吧。我們在這裡為反叛者提供武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They have their own weapons. And you lend them more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們有自己的武器。你們還借給他們更多？

scripts.text:
[Master]
You are right. But according to the task and circumstance, sometimes we need additional weapons
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你說得對。但根據任務和情況，有時我們需要額外的武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And for newbies, we don't know which gun is suitable for each of them. So they have to try many different guns.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
而且對於新手，我們不知道哪把槍適合他們。所以他們必須嘗試許多不同的槍。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So they can borrow them here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以他們可以在這裡借用。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Yes. They must write down the period, names and the purpose on the ledger. When returning them, they only have to sign.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
是的。他們必須在賬本上寫下期限、姓名和用途。歸還時，他們只需要簽名。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's inconvenient. I thought you would just lend them without any procedure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這很麻煩。我以為你們會直接借給他們，沒有任何手續。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Originally, they used to borrow and returned guns without having to write anything. But almost nobody returned them. We have limited resources so we cannot just keep producing and purchasing our weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
起初，他們借槍和還槍都不需要寫任何東西。但幾乎沒有人歸還。我們的資源有限，所以不能一直生產和購買武器。

scripts.text:
[Master]
That's how we developed a system like this. It's due to the guys living here.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這就是我們建立這樣的制度的原因。這是為了生活在這裡的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the ledger...

[Master]
Don't scrutinize it. Just in case you forgot, you are an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
別細看。萬一你忘了，你是外人。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Please keep in mind that we have been the most mysterious and exclusive organization in Schwaltzvalt lately.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
請記住，我們最近是施瓦茨瓦爾特最神秘和排他的組織。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's amazing. What are these red lines?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真令人驚訝。這些紅線是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Those who did not return weapons.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
那些沒有歸還武器的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So many of them.. Even if you manage it thoroughly?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼多...即使你們管理得很嚴格？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since these are not their private firearms, they handle them carelessly. They don't realize that they have to handle things with care.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
因為這些不是他們的私人槍支，他們處理得很隨意。他們沒有意識到必須小心對待這些東西。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Once they are broken, they must bring them here to repair. But they just throw them away. They don't bring them back here even though we give them penalty, claiming that they lost them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
一旦損壞，他們本該拿來修理，卻直接扔掉了。即使我們處以罰款，他們也不肯歸還，只說弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh! Great! Adventurer, if you have time, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦！太好了！冒險者，如果你有空的話，能幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text: I always like working.
scripts.translation: 我隨時樂意幫忙。

scripts.text: Sorry. I can't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All of a sudden? Maybe not now...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
突然叫我幫忙？現在恐怕不行...

scripts.text:
[Master]
Well, it's not urgent. Please find them when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯，不著急。等你有空的時候再去找吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All of a sudden? Well, I always like working.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
突然叫我幫忙？不過，我隨時樂意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It's good attitude. Please take a look the guys with red lines. And reclaim those weapons that they threw away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
態度很好。請去看看那些身上有紅線的人，把他們扔掉的武器收回來。

scripts.text:
[Master]
While they are on mission, most of them reclaim their weapons once they are broken. By the time they arrive at Einbech, they think of me who scolds them and just throw the weapons away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
執行任務時，大多數人在武器損壞後會將其收回。但等到回到艾音貝赫，想到我會責罵他們，就直接把武器扔掉了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Sometimes I reclaim them when I have time. Sometimes I send newbies to bring the. But as you see, we have been quite busy lately.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
有時候我有空會去撿回來，有時候讓新手去拿。但你也看到了，最近我們一直很忙。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And once you touch the wreckage...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
而且，一旦你觸碰那些殘骸...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happens?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
會發生什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Oh... Grudges of guns come out and attack you. You have to see them yourself. Seeing is believing.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
哦...槍的怨念會顯現出來攻擊你。你得親眼看看。眼見為實。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go around ^0000cdseveral places in the field below Einbech ^000000 and reclaim ^0000cdBroken Guns^000000 inside Suspicious Heap of Earth.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
去艾音貝赫下方野外的^0000cd幾個地方^000000，從可疑的土堆中找回^0000cd損壞的槍支^000000。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let me see from the newest one... Bring ^0000cdabout three of them^000000 please. If you bring too many of them, it will be hard to repair.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
讓我看看最新的...請帶^0000cd大約三把^000000回來。如果帶太多，修理起來會很困難。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Welcome back. Have you brought what I ask you for?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
歡迎回來。你帶了我需要的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master]
Hmm.. Not enough. I asked you to bring three Broken Gun.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
嗯...不夠。我讓你帶三把破損的槍。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Go down from Einbech and investigate Suspicious Heap of Earth in several places. Then you can find them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
從艾音貝赫下去，調查幾個地方的可疑土堆。然後你就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Since there are Grudges, I know it's not easy. But we will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
既然有怨靈，我知道這並不容易。但我們還是指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You've brought enough broken guns. But we cannot use them.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你帶回了足夠多的損壞的槍。但我們無法使用它們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I guess you have to search at least five Heap of Earth and defeat about five Grudge.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我想你至少需要搜尋五個土堆，並擊敗大約五個怨靈。

scripts.text:
[Master]
I know you worked hard for us to bring them. Sorry to ask you once again.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我知道你為了給我們帶回這些武器很努力。抱歉又要麻煩你一次。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You have brought enough amount. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你帶的數量足夠了。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Master]
By the way, he should be here now.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
順便說一下，他應該已經到了。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我在這兒。

scripts.text:
[Master]
And your weapon?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你的武器呢？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I don't have it.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我沒有。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Why not?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
I lost it.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
我弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Heck, good job.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
真是的，幹得不錯啊。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Well, not such a good job.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
嗯，這可不是什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Master]
You did a great job. So you'll lose your weapon again, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你做得很好。所以你會再次弄丟武器，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不會的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
What did I tell you? You can lost yourself, but never lose your weapon!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我跟你說過什麼？你可以弄丟自己，但絕不能弄丟武器！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Master]
It doesn't look like an attitude of someone who's sorry. You lost something you borrowed. Now give me yours.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這看起來一點也不像道歉的樣子。你弄丟了借來的東西。現在把你的交給我。

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Never! Don't touch me! Yikes!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不！絕不！別碰我！哇！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...我現在可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No, you can't! I don't know who you are. But please save me!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不行，你不能走！我不知道你是誰。但是請救救我！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Right! We have to compensate you. First, let's see who threw this away.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
沒錯！我們必須補償你。首先，讓我們看看是誰把它扔掉的。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Let's see... Who threw this away..? The serial numbers are...
scripts.translation:
[師父]
讓我看看...是誰把它扔掉的...？序列號是...

scripts.text:
[Master]
... Daryl?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
...達里爾？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
Yeah, huh?
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
是啊，怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Master]
The weapon you borrowed last time.. You said you lost it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你上次借走的武器...你說弄丟了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My god. Why is it there...
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
天哪。它怎麼會在那裡...

scripts.text:
[Master]
You begged me for the weapon!! Just because it's not yours, you broke it like this and threw it away? Why didn't you do this to your own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你可是苦苦哀求我才借給你的！！就因為它不是你的，你就把它弄壞然後扔掉？為什麼你對自己的武器不是這樣做的？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
My Lady!! I have to treasure it!!!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
女士！！我必須珍惜它！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
This is not the first time and I have the smoking gun here. You have nothing to say now!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
這不是第一次了，而且證據確鑿。你現在無話可說了吧！

scripts.text:
[Master]
We will keep your Lady for a while. You reflect on yourself in the training room for some time!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
我們會暫時留你的女士在這裡。你去訓練室反省一段時間！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Trainees!!!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
學員們！！！

scripts.text:
[Master]
Come and drag him out!
scripts.translation:
[師父]
過來把他拖出去！

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
What???
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
什麼？？？

scripts.text:
[Daryl]
No! Not the target please! I don't want to die yet!!! I'm sorry! It's my fault! I'll never do it again!
scripts.translation:
[達里爾]
不！請不要用靶子！我還不想死！！！對不起！是我的錯！我再也不會這樣做了！

scripts.text:
[Master]
You must be so tired by now. Take some rest. Can we count on you tomorrow? If you are interested, come back to us after the dawn.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
你現在一定很累了。去休息一下吧。明天能指望你嗎？如果你有興趣，天亮後再回來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Master]
Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[師父]
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You've reclaimed enough of them. Let's go back to the Master.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你收集得夠多了。讓我們回去找師父吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你為什麼帶這麼多東西？除非你想把它們送人，否則把背包清空點再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you carry so many stuffs? Unless you want to give them away, make your bag lighter and come back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你為什麼帶這麼多東西？除非你想把它們送人，否則把背包清空點再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you value your life, don't stimulate the people here. Many of them are short-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你珍視自己的生命，就別惹這裡的人。他們很多脾氣都很暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As you promised me, just drink a cup of tea and go back.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
既然你答應過我，就喝杯茶然後回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet all of them? They must be on the 2nd floor.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你都見到他們了嗎？他們應該在二樓。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can you see the doors on the 2nd floor? Just visit four of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你能看到二樓的門嗎？只要拜訪其中四間就行。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you behave yourself... nothing bad will happen. Maybe...?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
只要你表現好...就不會發生壞事。大概...吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Did you meet everyone on the 2nd floor? Great job. It must have been frightening.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你見到二樓的所有人了嗎？幹得好。那一定很嚇人吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although they are quite frightening... they are all good people.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然他們看起來很嚇人...但他們都是好人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Don't you have to report to Lazy now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你現在不是應該去見懶散嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rookie, how have you been?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
新人，最近過得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, how was your business? Lazy told me that I could fully trust you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，你的事情辦得順利嗎？
懶散跟我說，可以完全信任你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
All of us are also eager and preparing many things. We should not disappoint that person~
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們大家都很期待，也準備了很多東西。
我們不能讓那個人失望~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will do my best. Rookie, what have you been doing recently? How was your talk with Lazy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會盡力的。
新人，你最近都在忙什麼？
和懶散的談話怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I'm still here. This fellow cannot leave immediately. Neither can I.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我還在呢。
這傢伙不能馬上走，我也不能走。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What I've been doing recently?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我最近在忙什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer? I told you to take a good rest. Didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者？我讓你好好休息，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
At this time of the day, everyone is taking a rest. Please go back and rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這個時間點，大家都在休息。
請回去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'm afraid you will collapse from overwork. The health is the most important. Please take some rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我怕你會累垮了。
健康才是最重要的。
請好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我必須來這裡的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又來嘍！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, speak of the devil.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是說曹操，曹操到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yikes! It's cold!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哎呀！好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
My job is to prevent such a fool from doing silly things.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我的職責就是防止這種傻瓜做蠢事。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, come on! Who keeps putting the bucket here? Every time I take it away, somebody puts it here again! Who is it? Is it a pervert who enjoys watching other people's feet getting wet?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
喂！你怎麼能這樣對我？
是誰一直把水桶放在這裡的？
每次我拿走，又有人放回來！
是誰？
難道是喜歡偷看別人腳被淋溼的變態嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's me.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是我。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey! How can you do this to me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嘿！你怎麼能這樣對我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
As long as you ^0000cdwalk on the pipe^000000 instead of the stairs, it's your fault. The pipe is innocent. How can you do that to the pipe!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
只要你是^0000cd走水管^000000而不是走樓梯，那就是你的錯。水管是無辜的。你怎麼能對水管做這種事！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look. There are four walls and four corners. So there must be four stairs. There are only two stairs and it's so inconvenient on the sides where there are no stairs!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你看。這裡有四面牆和四個角落。所以應該有四個樓梯。但只有兩個樓梯，而且沒有樓梯的那兩邊太不方便了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do not complain it to me. Talk to the one who designed this place.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
別向我抱怨。去找設計這個地方的人說去。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Where is that person!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那個人在哪裡！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He's dead. Not here.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他死了。不在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
...... You are doing this to me on purpose, aren't you? Why do you hate mu so much?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
......你是故意這樣對我的，對吧？你為什麼這麼討厭我？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you think I put this bucket here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你覺得我為什麼要把這個水桶放在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Because you like to see my feet get wet.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
因為你喜歡看我的腳被淋溼。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey!!! Are you saying I'm a pervert? You keep walking on the pipe every day with that huge boday. As a result, this skinny pipe is damaged! There! And there! Can you see the water leakage?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！！！你在說我變態嗎？你每天都用那龐大的身體走在水管上。結果，這根細水管被弄壞了！看那裡！還有那裡！你能看到漏水嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦，確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I put the bucket there to receive the leaking water! Once the pipe is entirely broken, there will be a flood in this place! Don't you have the brain to think of it?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我把水桶放在這裡是為了接住漏出來的水！如果水管徹底壞了，這裡就會發洪水！你難道沒腦子想到這一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I didn't think about it. Why don't you repair the pipe?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯，我沒想過。你為什麼不修理水管？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's why I've been waiting here!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以我一直在這裡等著！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh~ I see. Then I'll count on you! Make it solid! If you have enough time, please make something I can hold on.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦~我明白了。那就拜託你了！把它修得結結實實的！如果你有時間，請給我做個可以抓握的東西。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No. I will just supervise it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不。我只是監督。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then who's going to repair it? There's nobody here.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那誰來修理？這裡沒有人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you sure there's nobody here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你確定這裡沒有人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I can't make our guest work.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我不能讓我們的客人幹活。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you know who it is?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你知道他是誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh... me?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哦...是我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Exactly! As a reward, I will give you an opportunity to bring the parts to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
沒錯！作為獎勵，我會給你一次機會，讓你去拿零件來修理管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well, I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哎呀，我很忙的...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I know you are off-duty today.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我知道你今天下班了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so hungry and have to eat... I should take care of my kitty... And...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我肚子好餓，得去吃飯...我還得照顧我的小貓咪...而且...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You are the one who damaged it. So you must repair it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是你弄壞的。所以你必須修好它。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please, please! To repair this, we need some metal things. To get them, I have to enter the mine!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
拜託，拜託！要修這個，我們需要一些金屬零件。要拿到它們，我得進礦坑！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's correct! Go get them now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
沒錯！快去拿吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm afraid of the mine. Please don't send me to the mine. Please... Brother, please...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我害怕礦坑。請不要派我去礦坑。拜託...哥哥，拜託了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, you are right. Then what shall we do...? We need to repair it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，你說得對。那我們該怎麼辦...？我們需要儘快修好它。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
What if someone else brings the parts and I repair it?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
如果別人把零件帶過來，我來修，這樣行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please do this for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
請幫幫我，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! How can you say that to the guest!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！怎麼能對客人這麼說！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Hey, why! Adventurers normally carry about 30,000 metal things in their pockets! That's what I found from most adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嘿，為什麼啊！冒險者通常口袋裡都裝著30,000個金屬零件！這是我觀察大多數冒險者得出的結論！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這...是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I never bring that many.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我從來沒帶過那麼多。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, look at that!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿，你看那個！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But you can get them so easily! Since we have only handled stuffs like guns, it's hard for us to get them. I've seen many adventures who get those items quite easily.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但你很容易就能拿到！因為我們只處理過槍之類的東西，所以很難弄到那些零件。我見過很多冒險者都能輕鬆拿到那些物品。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Is that... true?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這...是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it isn't...

[Denny]
Everyone says no to this question. But they still get them like a piece of cake! I saw them!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
大家都說做不到。但他們還是像吃小蛋糕一樣輕鬆拿到了！我親眼看到的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, I don't know whether it is true or not. But would you mind bringing them for us?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，我不確定那是不是真的。但您介意幫我們帶回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This pipe will be destroyed completely. Then there will be flood here. Since this place is a hideout, it will be revealed once it is flooded. Then... We will...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這根管道會徹底破裂。然後這裡就會發大水。既然這裡是據點，一旦發水就會暴露。到時候...我們就...

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好難過。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We really have to repair it urgently. But this guy cannot go to the mine due to a certain reason. Also, I cannot go to the mine for other job. We will certainly compensate for your support.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們真的必須緊急修復它。但這位先生因為某些原因無法去礦場。而我因為其他任務也無法前往。我們一定會補償您的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Compensate? You never told me about it! Let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
補償？你從來沒告訴過我！讓我去！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So you're going to the mine?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以你要去礦場？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
No...

[{0}]
Now that you mention it... I will go. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼一說...我去吧。你們需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We need ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們需要^0000cd5塊鋼和15塊舊鋼板^000000。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
And please ^0000cddefeat Scrap Heaters^000000. About 10 of them! This is my personal request!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
還有請^0000cd擊敗廢鐵火焰龜^000000。大概10只！這是我個人的請求！

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It will be difficult for me. I'm sorry that you have to find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對我來說有點難。抱歉，你們得找別人了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Oh, why!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
噢，為什麼！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
I'm so sad!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我好難過！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, he's so rude. We have no choice. I will look for someone else to do it. You don't have to worry about this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼，他真粗魯。我們沒得選。我會找別人來做。你不用擔心這個。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can do that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Look! What did I say? Every adventurer is strong!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看吧！我說了什麼？每個冒險者都很強！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey, would you reject it in front of someone? Adventurer? You don't have to do this.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿，你會在別人面前拒絕嗎？冒險者？你不必這樣做。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Welcome. See you soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
歡迎。回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Yes! We will be waiting!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
是的！我們會等著的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
小心！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Great job, adventurer. I must have been hard for you to take that job all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
幹得好，冒險者。突然接這個任務，對你來說一定很吃力吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又來嘍！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者！你都帶來了嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯……正如我所說的，請帶來^0000cd5塊鋼和15塊舊鋼板^000000。我們需要它們來修理管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，你真會走捷徑。我喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但我真的很需要它們。所以請把它們帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級明星丹尼現在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪門子的超級明星？畢竟我們都在指望你。他比看起來更執著。所以我替你說這句話。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你帶來了鋼和舊鋼板……

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看來你沒有擊敗^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我聞不到鐵的味道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
雖然這是我個人的請求，但我希望你能幫我做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級明星丹尼現在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of superstar is that? After all, we are counting on you. He is more persistent than he looks. So I am saying this for you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪門子的超級明星？畢竟我們都在指望你。他比看起來更執著。所以我替你說這句話。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~ 太棒了！你從不讓我失望！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的傳奇故事傳遍整個大陸！每個人都需要知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那麼我去準備修理了！我會再次指望你的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他說了想要什麼才回去。真任性！但我沒把他教成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
請今天好好休息。明天我們還會指望你。你一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我必須來這裡的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得聽所有人的抱怨。這是個問題。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪裡冷了？跟昨天一樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿，我的感覺真準。今天更冷。看。你穿得更多了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊！我什麼時候穿成這樣了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
讓我看看...我就知道。壁爐的火變弱了。沒有柴火嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
等這最後一根柴火燒完，我就要死了...最後...一根柴火...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰告訴你你會死的？你看起來很健康啊！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
拜託，別在我煽情的時候只跟著我念啊！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊，別死。如果你死了，那12個孩子怎麼辦。求你別死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿！誰是我的孩子！而且為什麼要我喂他們？怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的伴侶...在執行任務時去世了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
天哪！那我的伴侶是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...那隻泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！不不！我們就說這位冒險者是我的伴侶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！這太沒禮貌了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
冒險者~ 現在是不是很冷？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，這件外套看起來不錯。難怪你不覺得冷。我們總是收到便宜的衣服，所以很容易感覺到寒冷。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者現在很忙。你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
聽我說，看看周圍。這個地方是由鐵和石頭建造的寒冷建築。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
而且既然我們身處接近地下的地方，這裡總是寒冷潮溼。你知道那種感覺嗎？寒冷潮溼的空氣會要了我們的命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
所以我們要總是在壁爐裡生火來溫暖空氣，煮茶，烤一些紅薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
總之，那個壁爐真是天使之賜福，給了我們這麼多溫暖。但是柴火快用完了，火快要熄滅了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
因為太冷了，我出不去。親愛的，你能幫我帶些柴火來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！你對冒險者太無禮了！請分清現實和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哼，我分得很清楚。與其住在這冰冷的石頭房間裡，我寧願跳進河裡！

scripts.text: Do you need the fuel?
scripts.translation: 你需要燃料嗎？

scripts.text: I have to leave now.
scripts.translation: 我現在必須離開。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I leave now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在可以走了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, are you leaving me? I'm suffering from the cold weather!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，你要丟下我走嗎？我正在受凍呢！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, don't worry about Cyon. I will take care of this fellow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，別擔心賽昂。我會照顧這位女士的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, come back if you miss me!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，如果你想我了就回來吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！懂了！只要我帶燃料來，你就不會當場死亡，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可愛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又開始了。我得承認，你真有一套。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Trees, about 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please, three of them.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我需要一些燃燒一半的木材，大概10個。因為它們曬得很乾，燒起來很旺。還有更好的煤可以讓火持續更久。請帶3個煤來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？為什麼？它會產生太多灰燼。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
對我來說，效率才是最重要的！最暖和的才是最好的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. 10 Burnt Tree and three coal. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道了。請停止爭吵。我會去帶的。10個燃燒一半的木材和3個煤，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat 10 Waste Stoves!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！還要擊敗10個廢爐！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
你必須擊敗它們才能獲得煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜託了。冒險者肯定已經知道了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
小心點，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼...不管怎樣，我們就指望你了。不管那個人跟你說了什麼，一旦火滅了，大家都會感冒的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, seems like you gave so much effort!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，看來你費了不少力氣啊！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Welcome back, dear!!! Have you got them all for me? Right?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
歡迎回來，親愛的！！！你都給我帶回來了嗎？對吧？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，沒有啊。而且數量也不夠... 難道你忘了我們要你帶什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
10個燃燒一半的木材和3個煤。我好冷啊。再見，親愛的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
還有別忘了擊敗大約10個廢爐！我要去睡覺了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是嬌氣。冒險者，我們又要指望你了。如果你不帶回來，賽安會整天纏著你的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你有柴火... 那廢爐呢？你沒擊敗它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
你必須去弄，親愛的。廢爐只有被搖晃大約1000次後，才會掉落優質的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
擊敗^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我要去睡覺了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That's so spoiled. Adventurer, We will count on you again. If you don't bring them, Cyan will pester you all day long.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是嬌氣。冒險者，我們又要指望你了。如果你不帶回來，賽安會整天纏著你的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Wow! You've brought all of them! My dear, you are so reliable!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哇！你全都帶回來了！親愛的，你真可靠！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
好了。把木頭和煤放進去... 點火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，現在暖和了。就像你的愛一樣溫暖~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Could you please stop saying 'dear'? You are repeating my joke too much.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你能不能別老說“親愛的”？你重複我的玩笑太多次了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! You started!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿！是你先開始的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It was a joke. Joke! Joke! Joke!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那是玩笑。玩笑！玩笑！玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Anyway, I like the adventurer! I won't let the adventurer go! Never!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
總之，我喜歡這個冒險者！我不會讓冒險者離開的！永遠不！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
So my dear, will you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
所以，親愛的，你明天還會回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Not again!!!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
又來了！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
These are only enough for today. Of course we must make a fire every single day!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
這些只夠今天用的。當然，我們每天都必須生火！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Stop fighting. I will come back tomorrow if I remember.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我明白了。別吵了。如果我沒忘的話，明天會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear, you are so kind! But I may not be here tomorrow for a mission. Please don't be disappointed!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的，你真好！但我明天可能因為任務不在這裡。請不要失望！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I don't think the adventurer will ever be disappointed.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我覺得冒險者是不會失望的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Now I will go in and sleep. See you!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
那我現在去睡覺了。再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, I am exhausted as well. Please take a good rest now and come back after the ^0000cddawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼，我也累了。請好好休息，^0000cddawn^000000之後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
... You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我來這裡，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Twinkle twinkle little star~ My shooting star, you are still beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
一閃一閃亮晶晶~ 我的流星，你依然美麗。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's to make those kids quiet.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那是為了讓那些小孩安靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Are you fumbling it again! It might run down!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又在笨手笨腳了！可能會弄壞的！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It was you who told me to possess it all the time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是你讓我一直擁有它的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I didn't mean to wash it every hour! You're so stubborn!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我沒說要每小時洗一次！你真固執！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
By the way, that's not important. I think there is something terribly wrong with my shooting star.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
順便說一句，那不重要。我覺得我的流星出了大問題。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What? Flaw? Talk to the master there...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
什麼？瑕疵？去問問那邊的師父...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. That's not the flaw I am talking about. Although its name is Shooting Star, it doesn't twinkle at all.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
不。那不是我說的那種瑕疵。雖然它叫流星，但它一點都不閃。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What kind of flaw is that? It doesn't matter how it looks! The performance more important!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那算什麼瑕疵？外觀不重要！效能才更重要！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, Lucky... Lucky, Lucky! Although you live in a place like this, your sense has to be youthful. That's the way you stay young. It's as important as being physically healthy.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哦，拉基... 拉基，拉基！雖然你住在這種地方，但你的感覺必須保持年輕。這就是保持年輕的方式。這和身體健康一樣重要。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why is it so important?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼這很重要？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Okay. Here's an item with a good performance and dull outward. And here's another one with a good performance and good outward. Which one would you choose?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
好吧。這裡有一個性能很好但外觀平庸的物品。還有一個性能很好且外觀也很好的物品。你會選哪一個？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I like something dull.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我喜歡樸素一點的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Look at your taste... You really don't know the trend, do you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
看看你的品味... 你完全不懂潮流，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Regardless of the trend, it's my constant taste.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不管潮流如何，這是我恆久的品味。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes, I see. I respect your taste. Then please respect my taste too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是的，我明白了。我尊重你的品味。那麼請也尊重我的品味。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Right.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
... 好吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, what can I do? This part has to be thin... Right! I want to add some glitters to ammunitions.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀，我能怎麼辦呢？這部分必須做得薄一點... 對了！我想在彈藥上加些閃光粉。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why do you need them for ammunitions?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼彈藥需要閃光粉？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Since it's Shooting Star, it must twinkle! The Shooting Start that generates its last light by burning itself! The glitters will be spread... Just by imagining it, it's so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
既然是流星，就必須閃爍！那是燃燒自己發出最後光芒的流星！閃光粉會散開... 光是想像一下，就覺得太美了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you do that, you will get tracked.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你那樣做，就會被追蹤到的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
It's okay. I can publicize myself through the entire Continent. Let me grinder something hard and put it...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
沒關係。我可以通過整個大陸來宣傳自己。讓我研磨一些堅硬的東西，然後放上去...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well. Do as you wish. If you like converting so much, why don't you become an assistant of the master there?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
好吧。隨你便。如果你這麼喜歡改造，為什麼不去那邊當師父的助手呢？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I prefer being on active duty. By the way... How do I get them?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我更喜歡在一線工作。順便問一下... 我該怎麼弄到它們？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What are you talking about? You have to go out and get them yourself.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你在說什麼？你得自己出去找啊。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
No. I have these many stuffs to look after. Besides, I don't have enough time. Oh, adventurer! Wait please! Talk to me for a minute!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
不。我有這麼多東西要照看。而且，我沒有足夠的時間。哦，冒險者！請等一下！跟我聊一分鐘！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Yes! Yes! I really need your help now! I'm glad you are here so that I can ask you for a favor.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是的！是的！我現在真的很需要你的幫助！很高興你在這裡，這樣我就可以請你幫個忙了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I ask you what it is...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我可以問問是什麼事嗎...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Do you have any hard and glittering stone?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你有堅硬且閃亮的石頭嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't have any.

[Magenta]
So it was a false rumor that adventurers bring about 30,000 gems in their bags.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
原來“冒險者包裡裝著30,000顆寶石”是個謠言啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know where you heard that rumor from.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不知道你從哪裡聽來的謠言。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
My friend told me. Hmm.. What can I do? Can I ask you for a favor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
是我的朋友告訴我的。嗯...我該怎麼辦呢？冒險者，我可以請你幫個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, you shouldn't be asking such a thing. The adventurer is our guest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
