哎呀，你不該這麼說的。冒險者可是我們的客人。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: I'm quite busy...
scripts.translation: 我有點忙...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm quite busy...

[Rookie]
The adventure is busy! You shouldn't be asking such a thing!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者很忙！你不該這麼說的！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I see... Please come back if you remember it later on. I will be waiting for you. Bye... then.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我明白了...如果你之後想起來，請再回來找我。我會在這裡等你的。再見...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
See you later. Be careful.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
回頭見。小心點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's all right. What would you like to request?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it's true that adventurers are kind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
原來冒險者真的很善良！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I need some glittering stuffs to decorate my Shooting Star. Let me see... I need pieces of crystal and black crystal that twinkle transparently.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我需要一些閃閃發光的東西來裝飾我的流星。讓我想想...我需要透明閃爍的水晶和黑曜石碎片。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I wish I can go by myself and pick up good crystals one by one. But since I have to look after these stuffs, I cannot. I need so much time to clean and assemble them... Phew...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
要是我能自己去把好的水晶一個個撿回來就好了。但我得照看這些東西，走不開。清理和組裝它們需要很多時間...呼...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Of course I will compensate you for your support. Please help me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
當然，我會補償你的支援的。請幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Please bring ^0000cd 10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. You can get them by defeating ^0000cdObsidians and Minerals^000000. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
請帶來^0000cd 10塊水晶和10塊黑曜石^000000。你可以通過擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000獲得它們。小心點！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew. He's so loud. I will count on you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼。他真吵。就拜託你了，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. I know you are suffering from the weird guy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。我知道你被那個怪人折騰得很辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你來了！你把我要求的東西都帶來了嗎？讓我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
啊！！！數量不夠！！！冒險者，謝謝你幫助我們。但這還不夠！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑曜石^000000。這次請別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你可以從^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000身上獲得它們。所以去擊敗它們吧。我現在得走了。再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是夠複雜的。我們就指望你了。這傢伙還真是執著。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀，哎呀...你帶來了水晶...但你沒有擊敗足夠的黑曜石和礦石魔。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要黑曜石和礦石魔死亡時產生的特殊振動。那種振動能讓水晶碎裂成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
抱歉又要麻煩你了，冒險者。請擊敗^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只礦石魔^000000。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew, so complicated. We will count on you. That fellow is so persistent.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是夠複雜的。我們就指望你了。這傢伙還真是執著。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, you brought them all!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哦，你都帶來了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
So it is true that adventurers are so talented. I was a bit worried when I was requesting.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
看來冒險者確實很有天賦。剛才拜託你的時候我還挺擔心的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Where did you pick up that story?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你從哪聽來的這種說法？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Pick up that story? Are you saying the adventurer is not talented? After seeing with your eyes?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
聽來的說法？你是說冒險者沒有天賦嗎？明明是你親眼看到的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, I mean...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，我的意思是...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry. Lucky has so many things to do... I apologize on behalf of him.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
抱歉。拉基有很多事情要忙...我替他向你道歉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. It's okay.

[Magenta]
By the way, it's so beautiful, What a brilliant light... I would like to start working now.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
順便說一句，真美啊，多麼璀璨的光芒...我現在就想開始工作了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Oh, come to think of it... Adventurer! Can you bring them tomorrow? They are so beautiful and I would like to try everything.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哦，仔細想想...冒險者！你能明天把它們帶來嗎？它們太美了，我想嘗試所有的方法。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will come back if I remember it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我想起來的話，我會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I'm so glad!!! But I might be outside for a mission. In that case, don't panic and come back next time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
太好了！！！但我可能在外執行任務。如果是那樣，別慌，下次再來就好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will.

[Magenta]
Thank you so much! I should start working. Be careful!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
非常感謝！我該開始工作了。小心點！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
That fellow is really loud, isn't he? I apologize on behalf of him. Please take a good rest and come back ^0000cdafter the dawn^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這傢伙真的很吵，不是嗎？我替他向你道歉。請好好休息，^0000cd黎明之後^000000再來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我必須來這裡的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又來嘍！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Can't you please skip that performance?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你能不能別搞這種表演了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, did you rest well? I rested well after completing the repair. I know you are not curious about it, but I'm telling you before you ask me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，你休息得好嗎？我修完東西后休息得很好。
我知道你可能不感興趣，但在我被你問之前先告訴你吧。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But there's still some water leakage in the pipe. Once I repair one of them, there's another water leakage in another pipe.. I wish we could replace them with brand new pipes.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但是管道里還是有漏水的地方。
修好一處，另一處又漏了...真希望能換成全新的管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
That's why need Steel and Old Steel Plate.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
所以我需要鋼鐵和舊鋼板。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Please defeat the ^0000cdScrap Heater^000000 and bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
請擊敗^0000cd火焰龜^000000，並帶^0000cd5個鋼鐵和15箇舊鋼板^000000回來！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Cheer up!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
加油！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, I'm so busy. Sorry to request you again. Go, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，我太忙了。抱歉又麻煩你了。
去吧，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。感謝你的支援。
我們那個調皮的孩子給你添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
The adventurer is here?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者來了？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Here come Denny again, the superstar!!!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級巨星丹尼又來嘍！！！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer! Have you brought them all? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者！你都帶來了嗎？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Well... As I told you, please bring ^0000cdfive Steel and 15 Old Steel Plate^000000. We need them to repair the pipe.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
嗯……正如我所說的，請帶來^0000cd5塊鋼和15塊舊鋼板^000000。我們需要它們來修理管道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Adventurer, you know how to take shortcuts. I like it.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
冒險者，你真會走捷徑。我喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
But I really need them. So please bring them to me. Will you?
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
但我真的很需要它們。所以請把它們帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級明星丹尼現在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是個小少爺。我替他向你道歉。
剩下的物品就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
You have brought the Steel and Old Steel Plates...
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
你帶來了鋼和舊鋼板……

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Apparently, you did not defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I cannot smell the iron.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
看來你沒有擊敗^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我聞不到鐵的味道。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Although it is my private request, I wish you could do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
雖然這是我個人的請求，但我希望你能幫我做到。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Superstar Denny is going home now!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
超級明星丹尼現在要回家了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What a spoiled kid. I apologize on behalf of him. We will count on you for the rest items.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
真是個小少爺。我替他向你道歉。
剩下的物品就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Wow~~~ Great! You never disappoint me!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
哇~~~ 太棒了！你從不讓我失望！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Let me spread your legendary story around the entire continent! Everyone needs to know that!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
我要把你的傳奇故事傳遍整個大陸！每個人都需要知道！

scripts.text:
[Denny]
Then I will go and prepare for repairing! I will count on you again!
scripts.translation:
[丹尼]
那麼我去準備修理了！我會再次指望你的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
He went back only after saying what he wants. How spoiled! But I didn't educate him like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他說了想要什麼才回去。真任性！但我沒把他教成這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow. You must be exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
請今天好好休息。明天我們還會指望你。你一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我必須來這裡的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Yikes, it's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，好冷！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I have to listen to complaints of all the people. That's a problem.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我得聽所有人的抱怨。這是個問題。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What's so cold? It's the same as yesterday
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哪裡冷了？跟昨天一樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey, my feeling is so accurate. It's colder today. Look. You put on more clothes.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿，我的感覺真準。今天更冷。看。你穿得更多了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh! When did I get dressed like this!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊！我什麼時候穿成這樣了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Let's see... I thought so. The fireplace is weaker now. No firewood?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
讓我看看...我就知道。壁爐的火變弱了。沒有柴火嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, it's true.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯，確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Once this last firewood is burnt out, I will die... Last... firewood...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
等這最後一根柴火燒完，我就要死了...最後...一根柴火...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who told you that you'd die? You're so healthy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰告訴你你會死的？你看起來很健康啊！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Come on, Just echo my words while I'm sentimental!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
拜託，別在我煽情的時候只跟著我念啊！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Oh, don't die. If you die, who's going to take care of those 12 kids. Please don't die.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊，別死。如果你死了，那12個孩子怎麼辦。求你別死。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Hey! Who are my kids! And why do I have to feed them? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
嘿！誰是我的孩子！而且為什麼要我喂他們？怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Your spouse... died during a mission.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你的伴侶...在執行任務時去世了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My god! So who's my spouse?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
天哪！那我的伴侶是誰？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well... The Teddy bear?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...那隻泰迪熊？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! No! Let's say this adventurer is my spouse.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！不不！我們就說這位冒險者是我的伴侶吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! That's rude!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！這太沒禮貌了！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Adventurer~ Aren't isn't it cold now?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
冒險者~ 現在是不是很冷？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well. Not really...

[Cyan]
Oh, this jacket looks good. That's why you don't feel cold. We always receive cheap clothes so we can easily fell the cold.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，這件外套看起來不錯。難怪你不覺得冷。我們總是收到便宜的衣服，所以很容易感覺到寒冷。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The adventurer is busy now. What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者現在很忙。你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Listen to me and look around here. This place is a cold building made of iron and stone.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
聽我說，看看周圍。這個地方是由鐵和石頭建造的寒冷建築。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And since we are in a place located nearly underground, it's always cold and damp. You know the feeling? The cold and damp air kills us.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
而且既然我們身處接近地下的地方，這裡總是寒冷潮溼。你知道那種感覺嗎？寒冷潮溼的空氣會要了我們的命。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
That's why we always make a fire in the fireplace to warm the air, boil the tea and bake some sweet potatoes...
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
所以我們要總是在壁爐裡生火來溫暖空氣，煮茶，烤一些紅薯...

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
In any case, that fireplace is a blessing that grants us so many things. But the fire is about to go out due to the lack of firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
總之，那個壁爐真是天使之賜福，給了我們這麼多溫暖。但是柴火快用完了，火快要熄滅了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Since it's too cold, I can't go out. So would you please bring me some firewood, my dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
因為太冷了，我出不去。親愛的，你能幫我帶些柴火來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Hey! You're being rude to the adventurer! Just distinguish the reality and fantasy!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嘿！你對冒險者太無禮了！請分清現實和幻想！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Well, I distinguish them too well. Rather than living in this cold stony room, I would like to jump into the river!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哼，我分得很清楚。與其住在這冰冷的石頭房間裡，我寧願跳進河裡！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see! I got it! So you won't commit a suicide if I bring the fuel?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了！懂了！只要我帶燃料來，你就不會當場死亡，對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh dear, you are so kind and lovely.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀，你真是又善良又可愛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You've dont it again. I've gotta hand it to you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你又開始了。我得承認，你真有一套。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
I need some Burnt Tree. About 10 of them. Since they are well-dried, they will be burnt well. And there's better than coal to keep the fire long. Bring some coal please. Three of them.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
我需要一些燃燒一半的木材。大概10根。
因為它們曬得很乾，所以燒起來很旺。
而且沒有什麼比煤炭更能讓火持續更久了。請帶一些煤炭來。3塊。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Coal? Why? It leaves too much ash.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
煤？為什麼？它會產生太多灰燼。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
To me, the efficiency is the most important! The warmest is the best!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
對我來說，效率才是最重要的！最暖和的才是最好的！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Please stop fighting. I will bring them. ^0000cd10 Burnt Tree and three coal^000000. Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。請停止爭吵。我會把它們帶過來。
^0000cd10根燃燒一半的木材和3塊煤炭^000000。對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oops! And defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哎呀！還有擊敗^0000cd10個廢棄爐子^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You need to defeat them to get coal!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
你必須擊敗它們才能獲得煤！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come on. The adventurer knows it already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
拜託了。冒險者肯定已經知道了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Be careful, my dear~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
小心點，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Phew... We will count on you anyway. Regardless of what that fellow told you, everyone will get a cold once the fire goes out.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呼...不管怎樣，我們就指望你了。不管那個人跟你說了什麼，一旦火滅了，大家都會感冒的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. Our silly kid gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。感謝你的支援。
我們那個調皮的孩子給你添麻煩了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
What? Adventurer? My dear?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
什麼？冒險者？親愛的？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
My dear~~~ You're late! I've been waiting for you for a long time! Have you brought the right one again? I mean, the firewood.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
親愛的~~~你遲到了！我等你很久了！
你又帶對東西了嗎？我是說，柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's not there. And it's not enough... Perhaps you forgot what we told you to bring?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，沒有啊。而且數量也不夠... 難道你忘了我們要你帶什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
10 Burnt Tree and three coal. I feel so cold. See you, dear.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
10個燃燒一半的木材和3個煤。我好冷啊。再見，親愛的。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
And don't forget to defeat about 10 Waste Stoves! I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
還有別忘了擊敗大約10個廢爐！我要去睡覺了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我們有些孩子很任性...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, you have the firewood... What about Waste Stoves? You didn't defeat them?
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，你有柴火... 那廢爐呢？你沒擊敗它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
You must get them, dear. Waste Stoves release the fine firewood only after they are shaken about 1,000 times.
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
你必須去弄，親愛的。廢爐只有被搖晃大約1000次後，才會掉落優質的柴火。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Defeat ^0000cd10 Waste Stoves^000000. I will be sleeping in by bed. It's so cold!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
擊敗^0000cd10個廢爐^000000。我要去睡覺了。好冷啊！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我們有些孩子很任性...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Burnt Tree and coal, you have everything! That's why I like you, dear!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
燃燒一半的木材和煤炭，你全都帶來了！
這就是我喜歡你的原因，親愛的！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Okay. Put the wood and coal in... Fire!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
好了。把木頭和煤放進去... 點火！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Oh, it's warm now. As warm as your love~
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
哦，現在暖和了。就像你的愛一樣溫暖~

scripts.text:
[Cyan]
Thank you so much! I will count you again later on! MY DEAR!
scripts.translation:
[賽安]
非常感謝！我之後還會再找你的！親愛的！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又沒跟你道別就走了。抱歉，他就是這樣。
我們有些孩子很任性。但不是每個反叛者都這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
請今天好好休息。明天我們還會再麻煩你的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Although you didn't have to come here, you took the trouble. I mean... Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然你不必來這裡，但還是麻煩你跑一趟了。
我是說...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...You told me I had to come here, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...是你讓我必須來這裡的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Wait!!! Adventurer! Please talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
等等！！！冒險者！請跟我說話！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
I would be so sad if you leave without seeing me. I thought of a perfect design last night.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
如果你沒看到我就要離開了，我會很難過的。昨晚我想到了一個完美的設計。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
And I made various stuffs and now I ran out of crystals... Would you mind if I ask you to get them?
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我做了很多東西，現在水晶用完了...你介意幫我弄一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Defeat ^0000cdObsidian and Mineral^000000. Then bring me ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000 please.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
擊敗^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000。然後請給我^0000cd10個水晶和10個黑水晶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Eee you later! I have to go and arrange the stuffs I made. I will count on you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
回頭見！我得去整理我做的東西了。拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ouch, Sorry to request you again. It must be tough for you now.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
哎呀，抱歉又麻煩你了。現在對你來說一定很艱難吧。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Welcome back, adventurer. Thank you for your support. That flake gave you some trouble.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
歡迎回來，冒險者。感謝你的支援。那個碎片給你添了不少麻煩吧。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You've come! Have you brought everything I asked for? Let me see!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你來了！你把我要求的東西都帶來了嗎？讓我看看！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Ah!!!! Not enough quantity!!! Adventurer, I thank you for helping us. But this is not enough!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
啊！！！數量不夠！！！冒險者，謝謝你幫助我們。但這還不夠！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need ^0000cd10 pieces of crystal and 10 pieces of black crystal^000000. Please don't forget it this time!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要^0000cd10塊水晶和10塊黑曜石^000000。這次請別忘了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You can get them from ^0000cdObsidians and Mineral^000000. So defeat them. I have to go now. See you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你可以從^0000cd黑曜石和礦石魔^000000身上獲得它們。所以去擊敗它們吧。我現在得走了。再見！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我們有些孩子很任性...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Well, well.... You've brought the pieces of crystal... But you didn't defeat enough Obsidians and Minerals.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
哎呀，哎呀...你帶來了水晶...但你沒有擊敗足夠的黑曜石和礦石魔。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
We need a special vibration generated when Obsidians and Minerals die. That vibration enables the crystal to get broken into smaller pieces...
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
我們需要黑曜石和礦石魔死亡時產生的特殊振動。那種振動能讓水晶碎裂成更小的碎片...

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Sorry to request you again, adventurer. Please defeat ^0000cd10 Obsidians and 10 Minerals^000000. I will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
抱歉又要麻煩你了，冒險者。請擊敗^0000cd10只黑曜石和10只礦石魔^000000。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Sorry. Some of our kids are spoiled... We will count on you.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
抱歉。我們有些孩子很任性...就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
You brought them all again!!! I'm beginning to respect you!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
你又把它們全都帶來了！！！我開始尊敬你了！

scripts.text:
[Magenta]
Thank you so much! Can I ask you for a favor again next time? This is great!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪根塔]
非常感謝！下次我還能再請你幫忙嗎？太棒了！！！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There he leaves again without saying goodbye to you. Sorry about him. Some of our kids are spoiled. But not every Rebellion is like that.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
他又沒跟你道別就走了。抱歉，他就是這樣。
我們有些孩子很任性。但不是每個反叛者都這樣。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please take a good rest today. We will count on you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
請今天好好休息。明天我們還會再麻煩你的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
Please do us another little favor!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
讓我把他帶出來！
看來還有研究員像這樣躲著。
請再幫個小忙！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me take him out!
Seems like there are still some researchers hiding like this.
^4d4dffYou can stop searching and take a rest!^000000
We will search for the rest of them.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
讓我把他帶出來！
看來還有研究員像這樣躲著。
^4d4dff你可以停止搜尋，休息一下！^000000
我們會去找剩下的。

scripts.text: The boy with silver hairs looked at me. He frowned and turned his head.
scripts.translation: 那個銀髮的男孩看著我。他皺起眉頭，把頭轉開了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
Although you talk to him, he would not listen at all.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
雖然你在和他說話，但他完全不聽。
看來和那個女孩說話更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
.........

He held his lips tight and looking at me.
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他緊緊抿著嘴唇看著我。
看來和那個女孩說話更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Don't talk to Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
......別和雅娜說話。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Don't talk to me either.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
也別和我說話。

scripts.text:
He held his lips tight with a stubborn face..
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他緊緊抿著嘴唇，一臉倔強。
看來和那個女孩說話更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana... You're cute even when you're breathing...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜...你呼吸的樣子也很可愛...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
...?!!!
Why did you overhear me?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
...？！
你怎麼聽到了？

scripts.text:
He is furious. But he's the one who said that loud...
Seems like it's easier to talk to the girl.
scripts.translation:
他看起來很生氣。但明明是他自己說大聲了...
看來和那個女孩說話更容易。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Adventurer, could you please ask Jana?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
冒險者，你能幫我問問雅娜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean.... how much she likes her older brother...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我是說...她有多喜歡她的哥哥...

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya, I heard that.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
伊利亞，我聽到了。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Gosh! No, no... I was just...!!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
天哪！不，不是...我只是...！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I made cookies together with Jana. Yesterday, we read a book together. Tomorrow we will explore the dead mine...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我和雅娜一起做了餅乾。昨天，我們一起讀了一本書。明天我們要去探索廢棄的礦坑...

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev is be excited and boasting about what happened.
scripts.translation: 伊利亞·列別捷夫看起來很興奮，正在炫耀剛才發生的事。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I want to be called by my first name, Ilya...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我想讓你叫我名字，伊利亞...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I mean... by Jana. Not by you.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我是說...讓雅娜叫我。不是讓你。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Sometimes I wish she calls me 'brother'...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
有時候我希望她叫我“哥哥”...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Jana calls you Older {0}. And why does she call me Ilya...?!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜叫你“{0}前輩”。為什麼她只叫我伊利亞...？！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Shooting? I like it. But it's not the only reason I practice it.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
射擊？我喜歡。但這不是我練習的唯一原因。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because I have to support Jana. I will shoot anyone who puts a hand on Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
因為我必須保護雅娜。我會射殺任何對雅娜動手的人。

scripts.text: Ilya Lebedev looks quite excited.
scripts.translation: 伊利亞·列別捷夫看起來相當興奮。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to be treated as a child.
Do not stroke my head.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我不想被當成小孩子。
不要摸我的頭。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ilya is the only one who can call me Jana.
Call me Lebedeva.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
只有伊利亞可以叫我雅娜。
請叫我列別傑娃。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......Who are you?
You don't look like Rebellion.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
......你是誰？
你看起來不像反叛者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are right. I'm an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說得對。我是冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
How did an adventurer come in here?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
一個冒險者怎麼會跑到這裡來？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Are you the adventurer who defeated our commander?
So you're the one from the Secret Wings, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你就是打敗我們指揮官的那個冒險者？
原來你就是秘密之翼的人啊。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Huhu, the old guys here hate the Secret Wings, but we don't care.
Since we want to fight hard in a mission, we welcome your proposal.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
呵呵，這裡的老人雖然討厭秘密之翼，但我們不在乎。
既然我們想在任務中好好表現，那就歡迎你的提議。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Whatever Jana likes, I like it too.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
雅娜喜歡的，我也喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Have you brought any story filled with gunpowder?
...Well, we cannot be involved in the mission anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你帶來了什麼充滿火藥味的故事嗎？
……不過，我們反正無法參與那個任務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are still young.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們還太年輕了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...We'll become adults in the near future.
We are not that much younger compared to other people here. Does putting on several years make any difference?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……我們很快就會長大的。
比起這裡其他人，我們也沒小多少。多算幾年有什麼區別嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
They all know that we have better abilities than adults.
If it wasn't for one thing... No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
大家都知道我們的能力比成年人更強。
如果不是因為那件事……算了，不說了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
It's so annoying...
Ilya, tell the adventurer to go away.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
真是煩死了……
伊利亞，告訴那個冒險者讓他走。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
We don't want to talk to you any more.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
請離開。
我們不想再和你說話了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(So they started to hate me pretty early... What should I do?
Maybe I have to listen to ^0000CDRebellions around them^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(他們好像很早就開始討厭我了……該怎麼辦？
也許我得去聽聽周圍^0000CD反叛者^000000們的說法。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Ah, Ilya. That person keeps irritating me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
啊，伊利亞。那個人一直在惹我生氣。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please leave.
I won't forgive you if you distress Jana.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
請離開。
如果你再讓雅娜難過，我不會原諒你的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
We don't want to talk.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你又來了？
我們不想說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Ask them about the incident that happened in the past...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(問問他們過去發生的那件事……)

scripts.text: Ask them directly.
scripts.translation: 直接問

scripts.text: Beat around the bush.
scripts.translation: 旁敲側擊

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you throw a grenade to the civilian zone during your actual mission?
Why did you do that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你們在執行任務時，真的向平民區投擲了手榴彈嗎？
為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
What...!!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
什……麼！！

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Where did you hear this story!
Hey, why are you saying that?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
你從哪裡聽來的這種說法！
喂，你為什麼要這麼說？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Get lost! Stay away from Jana!
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
滾開！離雅娜遠點！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......Looks like a huge mistake. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……看來是大錯特錯了。還是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's something I would like to ask you.
I asked others and they say you were...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有件事想問問你們。
我問了其他人，他們說你們……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Why do you pry into our private affairs?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……為什麼要打聽我們的私事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I didn't pry into anything. I mean, they told me you look very tired these days...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我沒有打聽什麼。我是說，別人告訴我，你們最近看起來很疲憊……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We are tired because someone is irritating us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們之所以疲憊，是因為有人一直在惹我們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(......This is getting difficult. Let's go back to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……這越來越難辦了。還是回去找^0000CDElena Volkova^000000吧。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We don't want to talk to you. Just leave.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們不想和你說話。快走吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(...I guess they really hate me now.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(……看來他們真的很討厭我了。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
You're here again?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你怎麼又來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
( I did take the cookie... Where is it?
Let's go back to Ericsson and talk to him.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(我確實拿了那塊餅乾……它在哪裡？
還是回去找Ericsson問問吧。)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, guys?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，你們在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...Do you have so much free time? Why do you keep stalking us?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……你有那麼多空閒時間嗎？為什麼一直跟蹤我們？

scripts.text: There's something I would like to tell you.
scripts.translation: 我有件事想告訴你們

scripts.text: Want some cookie?
scripts.translation: 想吃點餅乾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't want to hear it.
Unless you pay us 1 million Zeny for listening to your story, leave now.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我不想聽。
除非你付給我們100萬Zeny作為聽你說話的報酬，否則現在就離開。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I don't know what you are up to. But we...
...Wait, where did you get this cookie?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我不知道你在搞什麼鬼。但是……
……等等，你這餅乾是從哪弄來的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Someone you know well told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一位你們很熟的人讓我把這個交給你們。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......Commander Adler?
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
……Adler指揮官？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And he also said this.
Trust me. And tell the adventurer if you have any problem.
This is my request. Could you please tell me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他還說了這句話。
相信我。如果你有任何問題，就告訴那位冒險者。
這是我的請求。能告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......What...
That.. is a lie. How can I trust an adventurer...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……什麼……
那……那是謊言。我怎麼可能相信一個冒險者……？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As I told you earlier, please think about commander Adler.
He's so worried about you. So am I, and so is commander Volkova.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就像我之前說的，請想想Adler指揮官。
他非常擔心你們。我也一樣，Volkova指揮官也是。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We...
No. We won't tell you.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們……
不。我們不會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please tell me one thing.
I heard you didn't ruin yourself like this before.
Why do you keep hurting yourself?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請告訴我一件事。
我聽說你們以前並不是這樣的。
為什麼你們一直在傷害自己？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Why do you say that? What do you know about us?
You know nothing!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
你為什麼要這麼說？你瞭解我們什麼？
你什麼都不知道！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
...I was so..
scared...... so...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……我當時好……
害怕……太……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Scared...?

[Jana Levedeva]
And then... I got out of shape...
So I was scared... I did so... on purpose... sniffle.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
然後……我就變得不像樣子了……
所以我很害怕……我是故意那樣做的……啜泣。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
......
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
......

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I'm sure you know what happened during our first mission... not long ago.
After that. Jana had such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我相信你知道我們第一次任務時發生了什麼……就在不久前。
在那之後。雅娜過得很艱難。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Because Jana and I had been so confident that we would do well.
Then it happened... and we... were so miserable.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
因為雅娜和我當時非常自信，以為我們會做得很好。
然後事情發生了……我們……非常痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Sniffle. We didn't throw the grenade on purpose and we didn't enjoy it either. It's out fault. But, but...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
啜泣。我們不是故意扔手榴彈的，我們也不喜歡那樣做。這是我們的錯。但是，但是……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We were punished and moved to USU... Then we felt that everyone else regards us as horrible kids.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們受到了懲罰，被調到了USU……然後我們覺得其他人把我們看作可怕的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
We wanted to talk to commander Ericsson. But we couldn't, because we were assigned to another unit.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
我們想和Ericsson指揮官談談。但我們做不到，因為我們被分配到了另一個單位。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We had no idea what to do. We just wanted to run away. Because everyone was blaming us and disappointed at us...
But we liked our unit and commander Ericsson...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們不知道該怎麼辦。我們只想逃跑。因為所有人都在責怪我們，對我們失望……
但我們喜歡我們的單位和Ericsson指揮官……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We thought that we had already ruined everything.
As everyone was already disappointed at us, we thought we could do whetever...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們覺得我們已經搞砸了一切。
既然所有人都對我們失望了，我們就覺得可以隨便做點什麼……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
As we acted at our pleasure, things got worse and worse... So we were sacred...
Then we began to believe that we were the worst and hopeless kids...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
隨著我們隨心所欲地行動，事情變得越來越糟……所以我們很害怕……
然後我們開始相信我們是世界上最糟糕、最沒希望的小孩……

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
It's just our excuse that nobody stopped us...
I'm sorry to have troubled you...
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
這只是一個藉口，說沒有人阻止我們……
很抱歉給你們添麻煩了……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I'm... sorry too...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我……也很抱歉……

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what happened... Now I know you suffered a lot.
Can I tell this to your commander?
Of course I won't tell anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來是這樣……現在我知道你們經歷了很多痛苦。
我可以把這個告訴你們的指揮官嗎？
當然，我不會告訴其他人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(You heard their story. Let's go to ^0000CDElena Volkova^000000 and tell her.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(你聽到了他們的故事。讓我們去告訴^0000CDElena Volkova^000000。)

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
......
We'll be scolded...
But we have no choice. It's our fault. Please report to our commander.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
……
我們要被罵了……
但我們別無選擇。畢竟是我們的錯。請向我們的指揮官彙報吧。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Call from USU commander?
She will tell us that story...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
是USU指揮官叫我們去的嗎？
她應該會告訴我們那個故事的……

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
We'll be kicked out...?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我們要被趕出去……嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm coming with you. I will defend you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會和你們一起去的。我會保護你們。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Thank you...
...I hope Jana cheers up.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
謝謝你……
……希望雅娜能開心起來。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Yes, I'm coming!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
是的，我來了！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I'm scared what she's going to tell us... But we will still meet her.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
我很害怕她會對我們說什麼……但我們還是會去見她的。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, It's Older {0} {1} !
By the way, we are quite sleepy now after wandering around all day long...
I wonder it's already time for us to be sleepy. Let's play together tomorrow...Zzz
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哦，是{0}{1}哥哥/姐姐！
話說回來，我們在外面逛了一整天，現在有點困了……
看來是睡覺的時間了。明天再一起玩吧……Zzz

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, It's Older {0} {1} !
Have you come to play with us? Or for another business?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哦，是{0}{1}哥哥/姐姐！
你是來陪我們玩的嗎？還是有別的事情？

scripts.text: I have come to play with you!
scripts.translation: 我是來陪你們玩的！

scripts.text: I have come for another business. But I wanted to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我有別的事。不過我想打個招呼。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
I see... If you are busy, we shouldn't bother you.
But please don't go away without coming back to us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
原來如此……如果你很忙，我們就不打擾你了。
但是請不要離開，記得回來找我們哦。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Wow! Really?
But Older {0} the truth is that you are not playing with us. Older {1} we are playing with you. Haha!
Hmm... What are we going to do?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哇！真的嗎？
不過大哥哥/大姐姐 {0} 其實是我們沒有在和你們玩。大哥哥/大姐姐 {1} 是我們在和你們玩呢。哈哈！
嗯……我們要怎麼做呢？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
嗯……指揮官埃琳娜讓我們培養一個愛好。
我覺得讀書是個不錯的愛好。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please borrow a book for us from the juvenile section of Prontera library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDIt's dizzy after being shaken 1,000 times^000000. Please borrow this for me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
請幫我們在普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區借一本書。
書名是……^0000CD《搖晃一千次後頭暈目眩》^000000。請幫我借這本書。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區有專門的借閱系統。你可以去問^0000CD青少年區圖書管理員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
嗯……指揮官埃琳娜讓我們培養一個愛好。
我覺得讀書是個不錯的愛好。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please rent a book for us from the juvenile section of Prontera Library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDRebellion, the history of liberty^000000. Please borrow this book for me.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
請幫我們在普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區借一本書。
書名是……^0000CD《反叛者：自由的歷史》^000000。請幫我借這本書。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區有專門的借閱系統。你可以去問^0000CD青少年區圖書管理員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Hmm.. Commander Elena told us to make a hobby.
I guess reading is a fine hobby. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
嗯……指揮官埃琳娜讓我們培養一個愛好。
我覺得讀書是個不錯的愛好。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
I would be glad if borrow a book for me from the juvenile section of Prontera library.
The book's name is... ^0000CDNorgroad Horizon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊利亞·列別捷夫]
如果你能幫我在普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區借一本書，我會很高興。
書名是……^0000CD《諾格萊德的視野》^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
The juvenile corner of the Prontera library has designated rental system. You can ask the ^0000CDlibrarian in charge of juveniles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
普隆德拉圖書館的青少年區有專門的借閱系統。你可以去問^0000CD青少年區圖書管理員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Today, we would like to go to Einbech mine to research explosives. But I guess it would be dangerous if only two of us go there.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
今天，我們想去艾音貝赫的礦洞研究炸藥。但我覺得只有我們兩個人去那裡會很危險。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean, you're dangerous for the mine? Right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的意思是，你們對礦洞來說很危險？對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
No! How can you say that? There are so many dangerous monsters in the mine!
And Jana says she's curious to see if there are materials suitable for our research...
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

味道很好！當然比不上露西奶奶做的。但依然很棒。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

前輩{0}，請嚐嚐！前輩{1}，這是給你的... 另外，能麻煩您把這五份分給周圍的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
To Milo, Mason and Rachel.
And to commander Adler and commander Elena as well, please.
Make sure you tell them we made these.
scripts.translation:

給米洛、梅森和拉赫。
還有指揮官阿德勒和指揮官埃琳娜，也請給他們。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

您的背包空間不足。

您忘了讓我借什麼書了嗎？被搖晃了1000次後頭暈目眩！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Did you forget what I asked you to borrow? 'Rebellion, the history of liberty'!
Last time I went there with Ilya, the librarian at juvenile section found it for me...
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
您忘了讓我借什麼書了嗎？《反叛者，自由的歷史》！
上次我和伊利亞去那裡時，青少年區的圖書管理員幫我找到了...

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Norgroad Horizon, please.
If you tell the book name to the librarian, he/she will hand it you.
scripts.translation:

《諾格萊德的視野》，請。
如果您把書名告訴圖書管理員，他/她會把它交給您。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh, you're back? Please give the book!

scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哦，您回來了？請把書交給我！
書...您沒有帶嗎？別告訴我您把它弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]

scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
如果您弄丟了...您必須去圖書館報告這本書遺失的情況。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back. Here's the book.

scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回來了。書在這裡。
所以您會自己還回去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Wow! I wanted to read this!
Thank you, Older {0}! Older {1} do you want me to read this book for you? This must be exciting!
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哇！我想讀這本書！
謝謝您，前輩{0}！前輩{1}，您想讓我為您讀這本書嗎？這一定很精彩！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Hmm, she's not mentioning about returning it.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（嗯，她沒有提到還書的事。）

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh! We're going to Einbech mine. Please implement a previous exploration for us.

哦！我們要去艾音貝赫礦洞。請替我們進行一次先期探索。

scripts.text:

Thank you for doing us a favor!

scripts.translation:

謝謝您幫我們的忙！
關於結果，我稍後會通知您！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Oh! We're going to Einbech mine. Please implement a previous exploration for us.
scripts.translation:
[雅娜·列別傑娃]
哦！我們要去艾音貝赫礦洞。請替我們進行一次先期探索。

scripts.text:
[Ilya Lebedev]
Please defeat 20 Venomous and 20 Noxious in Einbech mine and bring us one Explosive Powder.

請在艾音貝赫礦洞擊敗20只毒液魔和20只廢氣魔，並帶一份炸彈粉末回來。

scripts.text:

Thank you for doing us a favor!
Jana says she will inform you about the result after the experiment!!
scripts.translation:

謝謝您幫我們的忙！
雅娜說實驗結束後會通知您結果！！

scripts.text:
[Jana Levedeva]
Please bring them to the five people I mentioned.
They are Milo, Mason, Rachel, commander Ericsson and commander Elena.
scripts.translation:

請把它們交給我說的那五個人。
他們是米洛、梅森、拉赫、指揮官埃裡克森和指揮官埃琳娜。

scripts.text:

Oh, did you eat all those cookies?
You liked them, didn't you?
Oh, come on. How can you eat all of them!
scripts.translation:

哦，你把那些餅乾都吃光了？
你喜歡吃，對吧？
哎呀，你怎麼能全吃光呢！

scripts.text:

We will give you some more. Make sure you bring them to those five people please.
Glutton {0} Older {1} we will make you more cookies for you next time!

我們會再給你一些。請務必把它們交給那五個人。
貪吃的{0}，年長的{1}，下次我們會為你多做一些餅乾！

scripts.text:

What did they say?

scripts.translation:

他們怎麼說？
他們喜歡嗎？呵呵。
你不覺得我做飯很厲害嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Hello. Welcome to Prontera library.
For juvenile books, only designated rental service is available.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
你好。歡迎來到普隆德拉圖書館。
青少年書籍僅提供指定的借閱服務。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Have you lost the book you borrowed?
Yes... We accept your report of a loss.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
你弄丟了借的書嗎？
是的...我們接受你的遺失申報。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Please be careful next time.
If you lose the book more than once or damage it, we may forbidthe lending to you.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
下次請小心。
如果你再次弄丟書籍或損壞書籍，我們可能會禁止你借閱。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Hello. Welcome to Prontera library.
For juvenile books, only designated rental service is available. Which book are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
你好。歡迎來到普隆德拉圖書館。
青少年書籍僅提供指定的借閱服務。你在找哪本書？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Prontera library always welcomes juveniles who read books.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
普隆德拉圖書館永遠歡迎閱讀書籍的青少年。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
{0}, That book? Please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:

{0}，那本書？請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]

scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
你想要的那本書目前已被借出。請使用另一本書。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
{0}? Please wait a minute.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
{0}？請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Librarian in charge of juveniles]
Yes. Here it is. Please abide by the deadline.
scripts.translation:
[青少年區圖書管理員]
是的。在這裡。請遵守截止日期。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
怎麼了？

scripts.text: Give him the ring.
scripts.translation: 把戒指給他

scripts.text: Do you come here often?
scripts.translation: 你經常來這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Teaching juniors after retirement, I think of my son every now and then.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
退休後教導後輩，我時不時會想起我的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... And my wife who passed away, too.
I also think of my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
...還有我去世的妻子。
我也會想起我的女兒。

scripts.text: You gave him the ring.
scripts.translation: 你把戒指給了他。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... This ... ring is ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
... 這... 戒指是...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
Poor fellow.
In the end, this is the way you come back.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
可憐的孩子。
到頭來，你竟是這般回來的。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I was expecting this.
When I found his Pecopeco, I knew something was wrong.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我早就料到了。
當我發現他的大嘴鳥時，我就知道出事了。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
But as I didn't see it with my eyes,
I had a slight hope in my mind.
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
但因為沒有親眼所見，
我心裡還存著一絲僥倖。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
....
... Should I welcome you, to see you again like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
....
... 我該歡迎你嗎？以這種方式再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... Thanks.
...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
... 謝謝。
...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
... That rocket belongs to Cheiron.
When they told me they would take them to Geffen's Magic_tower ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
... 那些火箭屬於Cheiron。
當他們說要把它們送到吉芬的魔法塔時...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
I thought they would take good care of them.
... Why should my children end up like this?
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我以為他們會好好保管的。
... 為什麼我的孩子會遭遇這樣的不幸？

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
What should I do now?
My wife and children have passed away.
What can I do ...
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
我現在該怎麼辦？
我的妻子和孩子都去世了。
我能做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Benedict Windsor]
You ...
......
scripts.translation:
[本尼迪克特·溫莎]
你...
......

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Shrines and convents have a very close relationship.
They come to help us like this frequently.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
神龕和修道院有著非常密切的關係。
它們經常這樣來幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？

scripts.text: Hands Rosary.
scripts.translation: 遞上念珠

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I know this stuff.
This is the Rosary that she was holding tightly in her small hand when she first came to this convent.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我認識這個。
這是她剛來到這座修道院時，緊緊握在手中的念珠。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I can faintly feel the spirit of that girl, Sorin.
She's grown up a lot.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我隱約能感覺到那個女孩索林的靈魂。
她長大了不少。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She was a tomboy. But since she met Seyren, she often pretended to be modest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
她是個假小子。但自從遇見塞倫後，她經常假裝很矜持。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Jooshin loved the girl a lot, and she was taken so early.
....
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
Jooshin非常疼愛那個女孩，她卻這麼早離開了。
....

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Thank you very much for giving this to me.
May the blessing of Jooshin be with you forever.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
... 非常感謝你把這個交給我。
願Jooshin的賜福永遠與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
I used to visit the Capitolina convent with Sorin quite often.
With her high-spirited personality, she got along quite well with the monks.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我以前常和索林一起拜訪Capitolina修道院。
她性格開朗，和武僧們相處得相當融洽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
She also came here to relax when she needed some rest ...
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
她需要休息時，也會來這裡放鬆...

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... even though the path is quite rough.
If you are going back now, do you want me to send you to Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
... 儘管路途相當崎嶇。
如果你現在要回去，需要我送你回普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請。

scripts.text: No thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
If you need it later, do not hesitate to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
如果你之後需要幫助，請儘管告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
... Bye.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
... 再見。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
You can smelt your gears over there.
I don't take requests for personal production or smelting.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你可以在那邊熔煉你的齒輪。
我不接受私人定製或熔煉委託。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Who's there? A shopper?
I don't accept personal production requests.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
誰在那兒？是顧客嗎？
我不接受私人定製委託。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Wait, can I see that Thimble Of Archer?
This decoration is ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
等等，能讓我看看那個“弓箭手頂針”嗎？
這個裝飾是...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Hey! What happened to Alt?
He made this decoration for the Thimble Of Archer when he visited here for the last time.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
嘿！阿爾特怎麼了？
他上次來這裡時，親手為這個“弓箭手頂針”製作了裝飾。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
A jewel decoration on a Thimble Of Archer! I know it sounds crazy. But it took him several days ? he didn't even sleep!
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
在“弓箭手頂針”上鑲嵌寶石裝飾！聽起來很瘋狂。但他花了好幾天...甚至都沒睡覺！

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Since he was having a hard time making it, I was willing to help him. But he still made this Thimble Of Archer alone ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
因為他製作得很辛苦，我本想幫他一把。但他還是獨自完成了這個“弓箭手頂針”...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Why do you have this?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
你為什麼要拿著這個？

scripts.text: It's a relic.
scripts.translation: 這是一件遺物。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What?
No ... Wait ... Wait a minute
I heard some rumors. I did ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 什麼？
不... 等等... 等一下
我聽到過一些傳聞。我確實...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
But I still believed that no news is good news ...
In this way, all of a sudden ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
但我一直相信沒有訊息就是好訊息...
就這樣，突然之間...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... What ... What a fool.
Why did he make a gift that he cannot even deliver?
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 真是... 真傻。
他為什麼要製作一份連送都送不出去的禮物？

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Haa ...
Eventually, this is how it ends ...
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 唉...
到頭來，結局還是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Thank you ... for coming all the way here.
I have to delay my work for a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
謝謝你... 大老遠來到這裡。
我得暫停工作一會兒。
....

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
Alt has an older brother.
... I will give this to him.
Since he is in a critical moment now, I will look for a chance to give it to him.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
阿爾特有個哥哥。
... 我會把這個交給他。
既然他正處於關鍵時刻，我會找個機會送給他。

scripts.text:
[Cleaver]
... Damn.
I cannot resume my work.
scripts.translation:
[克利弗]
... 該死。
我沒法繼續工作了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
... If you want to become an Assassin, go east of the desert.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
... 如果你想成為刺客，去沙漠以東。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's quite unusual.
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
這很不尋常。
是什麼把你帶到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
This dagger is ...
Right. Eremes ...
has finally returned.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
這把短劍是...
沒錯。艾雷姆斯...
終於回來了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
It's been a long time since I dispatched him ... He returned too late.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我派他出去已經很久了...他回來得太晚了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Is this mission failure or success?
... He is the type of guy who hates to have a mission fail.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
這次任務是失敗還是成功？
...他是那種討厭任務失敗的人。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I like guys who are serious about completing their missions. But in this case ... I wish he had just abandoned his mission and taken a vacation.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我喜歡那些認真完成任務的人。但在這種情況下...我希望他直接放棄任務去度假就好了。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
I will take him ... well.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
我會收留他...嗯。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
In this field, it is quite common to not have your companion come back after a mission.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
在這個行當裡，同伴執行任務後沒能回來是很常見的事。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
Some lucky guys come back like this.
And he was quite lucky.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
有些幸運兒能像這樣回來。
他相當幸運。

scripts.text:
[Guile Marovitz]
There's no need to be sad.
But it's just regrettable.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾·馬羅維茨]
沒必要難過。
只是有點遺憾。
僅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
In the past, the Hunter guild was in the Payon Forest.
And I grew up in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
過去，獵人公會位於斐揚樹林。
而我是在斐揚長大的。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
That's why I visit Payon once in a while.
....
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
所以我會偶爾去斐揚看看。
....

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
For some reason, I felt like coming here today.
Maybe it was for this.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
不知為何，今天我想來這裡。
也許就是為了這件事。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
My silly sister.
... As a matter of fact, she cannot sew well.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
我那傻妹妹。
...事實上，她針線活很差。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
She can barely sew on a button.
.......
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
她連釦子都縫不好。
.......

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
One day, she asked me.
Would it be better for me to act more like a girl?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
有一天，她問我。
我是不是應該表現得像個女孩一點？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
Maybe I can just sew on a single button?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
也許我可以試著縫一顆釦子？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
So I gave her this sewing box.
I don't know who she was thinking about when she took this.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
所以我給了她這個針線盒。
我不知道她拿著這個時在想誰。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
.........
The spare button is missing.
... Would she have sewn it on well?
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
.........
備用釦子不見了。
...她縫好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
I expected this, but I never imagined this thing would come back.
... Since it was her choice ... I must accept this ... But ...
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
我預料到了，但沒想到這東西會回來。
...既然是她的選擇...我必須接受...但是...

scripts.text:
Sherine is holding back her tears.
Leave her alone.
scripts.translation:
謝琳在強忍淚水。
請讓她獨處一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Sherine]
... Thank ... you ...

[Sherine]
... Please leave me alone.
... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[謝琳]
...請讓我一個人待著。
...對不起。
